title: Seven parties form new ‘Progressive Front’ in Nepal - Khabarhub
description: Seven parties form new ‘Progressive Front’ in Nepal  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Seven Madhesh-focused political parties have jointly announced the formation of a new political alliance named the ‘Progressive Front’.

The alliance was announced at a programme held at Kathmandu Banquet in Thapagaun on Saturday. The participating parties include Janata Samajbadi Party Nepal, Janamat Party, Aam Janata Party, Pragatisheel Loktrantrik Party, Nagarik Unmukti Party Nepal, Nepal Sanghiya Samajbadi Party and Bahujan Ekta Party Nepal.

The Progressive Democratic Party, which includes former Maoist deputy general secretary Janardan Sharma and former Rastriya Swatantra Party leader Santosh Pariyar, is also part of the new front.

The formation comes amid ongoing efforts among Madhesh-based parties to strengthen political cooperation. With seven parties coming together, the new alliance is expected to have an impact on Nepal’s emerging political equations.

The front is preparing to move forward on the basis of shared political issues and common agendas.

title: How Beijing Just Flexed Its Diplomatic Muscle In Kathmandu – And Won - ETV Bharat
description: How Beijing Just Flexed Its Diplomatic Muscle In Kathmandu – And Won  ETV Bharat
publisher.title: ETV Bharat
full_article:
Kathmandu: Despite recent perceptions in China that the new youth-led government in Nepal might tilt towards the West and not China, the abrupt cancellation of an international meet on Tibetan studies proved otherwise.

That move illustrated that Kathmandu continues to remain responsive to Beijing’s sensitivities, especially when it comes to Tibetan issues, and that it doesn’t matter whether it’s cultural, religious, political or even academic matters.

Nepal shares its northern border, measuring some 1,450m, with the Tibetan Autonomous Region of China, and has been home to nearly 15,000 Tibetan refugees - who fled Tibet, alongside their spiritual leader the Dalai Lama, after the 1959 uprising.

That Kathmandu’s close ties with Beijing remain as intact became clear this week when Nepal’s Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee requested the organiser of the Tibetan studies gathering, Kathmandu University (KU), to cancel the 17th International Association for Tibetan Studies (IATS) seminar, due to take place in Kathmandu from August 23 to 29.

It was expected to see a gathering of over 7,000 scholars of Tibetan and Buddhist studies from nearly 40 countries, including 159 from the United States and nearly 100 from China.

Karkee’s move followed last-minute Chinese concerns about the gathering, conveyed on July 21 to Nepal’s Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai by Chinese Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming.

China was particularly concerned about possible representation of delegates close to, or sympathetic to, the Tibetan exile administration based in Dharamsala, India, who, it feared, could have used the forum to criticise Beijing’s recent policies, including those currently being implemented in Tibet promoting national unity, reports said.

“We advised the organisers that it would be better not to hold the event,” a report in The Kathmandu Post quoted Chief Secretary Karkee as saying.

“It could be sensitive, several concerns might arise, and it could pose security risks. So we advised the organisers, in good faith, to cancel the event.”

The Post report noted that the sudden order to cancel the meet, which is said to have taken four years for the university to prepare, came despite clearance from Nepal’s Home Ministry and security officials who earlier said that the international conference would not throw up any security risks.

China is an important neighbour of Nepal.

On October 13 2019, visiting Chinese President Xi Jinping famously warned that “anyone attempting to split China will end in crushed bodies and shattered bones”.

title: Deuba reschedules return to Nepal for daytime airport reception - The Kathmandu Post
description: Deuba reschedules return to Nepal for daytime airport reception  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Former prime minister and former Nepali Congress president Sher Bahadur Deuba is returning to Nepal on August 13, ahead of a major gathering of his faction, with party cadres preparing to welcome him at Tribhuvan International Airport.

Deuba was initially scheduled to arrive in Kathmandu at 9:45 pm on August 11. He will now land at 12:25 pm on August 13 on a Thai Airways flight via Bangkok.

Congress leader Prakash Sharan Mahat said the late-night arrival was changed following requests from party leaders and workers who wanted to gather at the airport in large numbers to welcome Deuba.

Mahat said party loyalists planned to reach the airport well before midday. Former Central Working Committee chief secretary Krishna Paudel also confirmed Deuba’s revised travel itinerary.

Deuba left Nepal for Singapore on February 25 for medical treatment, missing voting in the House of Representatives election. His return comes after nearly five and a half months away from Nepal’s domestic political scene.

The revised schedule comes as Deuba’s faction in the Nepali Congress prepares to hold a national gathering in Kathmandu from August 14 to 16. The three-day gathering is expected to bring together party office-bearers, former ministers, lawmakers, local representatives and delegates from overseas diaspora organisations.

Deuba’s prolonged stay abroad came amid financial investigations by the Department of Money Laundering Investigation and the Central Investigation Bureau of Nepal Police. The investigations involve Deuba and his wife, former foreign minister Arzu Rana Deuba.

After the government issued arrest warrants against the couple in April, authorities approached Interpol seeking Red Notices. Interpol, however, rejected the request.

The couple subsequently filed legal petitions, following which the Supreme Court issued an interim order directing law enforcement agencies not to execute the arrest warrants on jurisdictional grounds concerning the Special Court.

In June, Deuba and Rana submitted written communications to the investigating authorities from abroad, saying they were away solely for medical treatment and had no intention of absconding.

Nepal has cancelled a major international conference on Tibetan studies after sustained pressure from Beijing, overruling its own security agencies which had already cleared the event following routine vetting, top Indian intelligence sources told CNN-News18 .

The 17th International Seminar of the International Association for Tibetan Studies was scheduled to bring together more than 500 scholars from across the world for a seven-day programme on Tibetan history, culture and related issues.

According to the sources, Chinese officials, including Ambassador Zhang Maoming, held high-level meetings with Nepal’s Foreign Ministry and urged the Nepalese authorities to remain vigilant against discussions seen as supportive of Tibet or statements concerning the Dalai Lama.

The pressure intensified shortly before the decision to cancel the event, with visiting senior Chinese representatives also lobbying the Nepalese leadership in Kathmandu, the sources said.

Among them was Venerable Master Yinshun, a member of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference, who was in Nepal in the period leading up to the cancellation.

Security Clearance Overruled

Nepal’s internal security agencies had already cleared the conference after routine security vetting, according to the intelligence sources. However, the assessment of the domestic agencies was ultimately overruled following diplomatic and political pressure linked to Beijing.

Chief Secretary Govinda Bahadur Karkee, in consultation with Foreign Secretary Amrit Bahadur Rai, personally instructed Kathmandu University to halt the conference, the sources said.

The decision was taken without the matter going through the Cabinet, according to the information available with CNN-News18 .

The episode is being viewed by Indian intelligence officials as a significant indication of Beijing’s growing influence within Nepal’s senior civil service and security establishment.

Beijing’s Concerns Over Tibet Discussions

China had raised concerns over the possibility that the conference could become a platform for discussions or statements on Tibet that went beyond academic scholarship, according to the sources.

The participation of Tibetan exile scholars was among the issues that caused unease within the Nepalese administration.

Officials were also concerned that public remarks during the seven-day event could turn the gathering into a platform for activist messaging on Tibet and the Dalai Lama, rather than remaining confined to academic discussions.

Nepal has long maintained a strict commitment to the One China principle and has avoided allowing activities on its territory that Beijing considers supportive of Tibetan separatism or anti-China political activity.

The prospect of more than 500 international scholars gathering in Kathmandu to discuss Tibetan history, culture and political questions was therefore seen by Nepalese officials as carrying the risk of friction with Beijing, the sources said.

There were also concerns within the administration that proceeding with the conference could affect Nepal’s wider bilateral relationship with China, including its trade and aid ties.

Venue Raised Monitoring Concerns

The scheduled venue, Hotel Soaltee in Kathmandu, also became a point of concern.

The hotel regularly hosts Chinese diplomatic delegations, raising security and privacy concerns over the possibility of participating scholars and delegates being monitored, according to the intelligence assessment.

Indian intelligence sources said the concerns have to be seen against what they described as an expanding Chinese intelligence infrastructure in Nepal aimed at tracking, profiling and restricting the movement of Tibetan refugees and international scholars.

The sources said such mechanisms are increasingly being used to closely watch Tibetan-linked activity inside Nepal, particularly events involving international participation or the possibility of politically sensitive discussions.

Part Of Wider Chinese Push In South Asia

सूत्रक कहब अछि जे आयोजन रद्द करबाक निर्णय सँ किछुए देर पहिने ई दबाव तेज भ गेल छल, आबय वाला चीन के वरिष्ठ प्रतिनिधि सेहो काठमांडू मे नेपाली नेतृत्व के पैरवी केने छलाह ।

एहि मे चीनी जन राजनीतिक परामर्शदात्री सम्मेलन के सदस्य पूज्य मास्टर यिनशुन सेहो छलाह जे रद्द करय सं पहिने के अवधि मे नेपाल मे छलाह.

सुरक्षा निकासी खारिज

ई प्रकरण क॑ भारतीय खुफिया अधिकारी न॑ नेपाल केरऽ वरिष्ठ सिविल सेवा आरू सुरक्षा प्रतिष्ठान के भीतर बीजिंग केरऽ बढ़तऽ प्रभाव के एगो महत्वपूर्ण संकेत के रूप म॑ देखै छै ।

तिब्बत चर्चा पर बीजिंग के चिंता |

सूत्रऽ के अनुसार चीन न॑ ई संभावना प॑ चिंता जतैन॑ छेलै कि ई सम्मेलन तिब्बत प॑ चर्चा या बयान के मंच बनी सकै छै जे शैक्षणिक विद्वता स॑ भी आगू बढ़ी जाय ।

नेपाली प्रशासन के भीतर बेचैनी पैदा करै वाला मुद्दा में तिब्बती निर्वासन विद्वान के सहभागिता भी शामिल छेलै ।

सूत्र सब कहलनि जे, तिब्बती इतिहास, संस्कृति आ राजनीतिक सवाल पर चर्चा करय लेल काठमांडू मे 500 सं बेसी अंतरराष्ट्रीय विद्वान जमा हेबाक संभावना के नेपाली अधिकारी सब बीजिंग के संग घर्षण के जोखिम उठाबय वाला बुझलक।

भारतीय खुफिया अधिकारी ई रद्द करला क॑ चीन केरऽ एगो व्यापक रणनीति के हिस्सा मान॑ छै जेकरा स॑ पूरा दक्षिण एशिया म॑ तिब्बती प्रवासी गतिविधि प॑ रोक लगाय देलऽ जाय ।

title: Nepal's roads don’t last the rains - Nepali Times
description: Nepal's roads don’t last the rains  Nepali Times
publisher.title: Nepali Times
full_article:
Nepal recently amended its Public Procurement Act, replacing the long-criticised lowest-bid rule with an average-bid evaluation system. The reform was overdue, and its intent is sound: to stop the race to the bottom that allowed contractors to underprice projects, cut corners, and recover costs through delays, variations, and quietly compromised construction.

Last year in Syangja, I came across a problem that suggests the issue is larger than any single procurement rule can fix. The road had been widened outward toward the cliff edge instead of being cut into the slope above. The pavement had already cracked in places. Heavy gabion walls held up the outer edge, but the entire stretch looked less like a finished road and more like a structure fighting gravity.

Residents told me the safer option had been obvious from the beginning: a modest cut into the hillside would have been simpler, cheaper and more stable. They had raised concerns when construction began, but the widening proceeded. The contractor had made a financially convenient choice, an engineer had supplied a justification after the fact. Nobody was held accountable.

A municipal road in Syangja. Photo: RANJAN BHATTA

The amendment to the procurement law might have changed how that contract was awarded. It would not, on its own, have changed what got built.

Nepal's mountain roads are among the most visible signs of government presence and one of the largest recipients of public capital spending. They connect villages, reduce travel time, and symbolise recognition from the state. But too often, roads are planned and built for visibility before elections rather than for durability after the monsoon.

Nepal has made undeniable progress in expanding road access over the past three decades. Communities that were once days away from markets, schools and health services are now just minutes or hours away. But are we building roads that remain safe, functional and resilient over their full life cycle?

RIBBON CUTTING

Roads are powerful electoral currency. A new alignment can be announced, photographed and inaugurated within a political term. Maintenance, drainage, slope stabilisation, and long-term resilience are less visible and carry no votes. The incentive is therefore to build quickly, extend reach and show immediate results. The cost arrives later, when the monsoon exposes what was ignored during design and construction.

Engineering standards exist for a reason. Decisions about slope cutting, retaining structures, drainage and alignment should be guided by terrain, hydrology and long-term stability. In practice, those decisions are shaped by competing pressures from contractors, elected representatives, administrative timelines and fragmented oversight. Municipal engineers frequently understand the risks, but they often lack the institutional authority or support to insist on better choices.

Poorly engineered highways scar slopes in southern Lalitpur. Photo: KUNDA DIXIT

What is later described as a technical failure is almost always a governance failure first. Cracks appear on the road surface, but the problem begins much earlier in procurement decisions, design compromises, weak supervision and unclear accountability.

The procurement amendment must be matched by stronger project preparation, independent supervision and clearer accountability through the full life cycle of every project from site assessment to post-monsoon review. Changing the bidding formula without fixing these foundations risks producing the same roads under a different rule.

Municipal finance officers know the cycle well. Roads deteriorate during the monsoon. Emergency repairs consume budgets that could have funded proper planning or more resilient construction. Municipalities end up building, repairing and rebuilding the same infrastructure while the underlying incentives remain unchanged.

Federal restructuring has made accountability more complicated. Many local roads are financed by provincial or federal sources, implemented by municipalities, supervised by multiple agencies and constructed by contractors operating across political networks.

When a road fails, responsibility becomes diffuse. The municipality points to the contractor. The contractor points to the design. The funding agency points to implementation. Communities which bear the direct cost are left with damaged infrastructure and little recourse.

NOT NATURAL

The environmental consequences are not accidents. Landslides triggered by poor slope cutting, subsidence caused by unstable fills, blocked drainage and undersized culverts are routinely treated as ‘natural' disasters. They are not, they are governance outcomes.

As rainfall becomes more intense and unpredictable, every shortcut is more expensive. A road that might have survived under older rainfall patterns may now fail under heavier monsoon events. What appears in the news as a sudden disaster is often the delayed result of choices made years earlier in a budget meeting, a design office or an election campaign. Climate does not create weak roads. It reveals weak decisions.

Nepal does not lack capable engineers or technical knowhow. What it lacks is a governance environment where technical judgment, fiscal planning and climate risk outweigh short-term political incentives.

Procurement reform is necessary but insufficient. It must be matched by stronger project preparation, independent supervision, clearer accountability across all tiers of government and meaningful community participation before construction begins.

Above all, climate risk must be treated as a fundamental design requirement, not a box to be checked after the alignment has already been decided. In fragile mountain terrain, resilience is not an optional upgrade. It is the condition for whether public infrastructure remains useful at all.

As another subnational election cycle approaches, roads will once again dominate speeches, banners and budget promises. The real test of political leadership is no longer how many kilometres are inaugurated before polling day. It is whether those roads remain standing after the ribbon-cutting, after the votes are counted and before the next monsoon arrives.

Roads rarely fail simply because it rains. They fail because decisions made years earlier ignored the realities of the landscape they were meant to serve.

नेपाल न॑ हाल ही म॑ अपनऽ लोक खरीद अधिनियम म॑ संशोधन करी क॑ बहुत दिन स॑ आलोचना करलऽ जाय रहलऽ सबसें कम बोली वाला नियम के जगह औसत बोली वाला मूल्यांकन प्रणाली के काम करलकै । सुधार केरऽ समय समाप्त होय गेलऽ छेलै, आरू एकरऽ मंशा सही छै: नीचें तलक के दौड़ क॑ रोकना जेकरा स॑ ठेकेदारऽ क॑ परियोजना केरऽ कम दाम, कोना म॑ कटौती, आरू देरी, भिन्नता, आरू चुपचाप समझौता करलऽ गेलऽ निर्माण के माध्यम स॑ लागत वसूली के अनुमति मिललै ।

पिछला साल स्यांगजा मे हमरा एकटा एहन समस्या सामने आयल छल जाहि स इ बुझना जाइत अछि जे इ मुद्दा ओहि स पैघ अछि जतेक कोनो एकटा खरीद नियम ठीक क सकैत अछि। सड़क ऊपर ढलान मे काटि क' बाहर दिस चट्टानक किनार दिस चौड़ा क' देल गेल छल. फुटपाथ पर जगह-जगह दरार पड़ि चुकल छल। भारी गैबियन देबाल बाहरी किनार के ऊपर धयने छल, मुदा पूरा खंड तैयार सड़क कम आ गुरुत्वाकर्षण सं लड़य वाला संरचना जकाँ बेसी बुझाइत छल.

निवासी सब हमरा कहलनि जे सुरक्षित विकल्प शुरूए सं स्पष्ट छल : पहाड़ीक ढाल में मामूली कटौती सरल, सस्ता आ स्थिर रहैत. निर्माण शुरू भेला पर ओ सब चिंता जतौने छलाह, मुदा चौड़ाई आगू बढ़ल। ठेकेदार आर्थिक रूप स सुविधाजनक चुनाव केने छल, एकटा इंजीनियर तथ्य क बाद एकटा औचित्य सप्लाई केने छल। ककरो जवाबदेही नहि देल गेल।

स्यांगजा के एक नगर निगम सड़क। फोटो : रंजन भट्ट

खरीद कानून मे संशोधन स शायद बदलाव आबि सकैत छल जे ओ ठेका कोना देल गेल। ई, अपने आप मे, जे बनल छल, ओकरा बदलि नहि दैत।

नेपालक पहाड़ी सड़क सरकारी उपस्थितिक सबसँ बेसी देखबा मे आबय बला संकेत मे सँ एक अछि आ सार्वजनिक पूँजी खर्चक सबसँ पैघ प्राप्तकर्ता मे सँ एक अछि । ई सब गाम के जोड़ै छै, यात्रा के समय कम करै छै, आरू राज्य स॑ पहचान के प्रतीक छै । लेकिन बहुत बार मानसून के बाद स्थायित्व के लेल नै चुनाव स॑ पहल॑ दृश्यता लेली सड़कऽ के योजना आरू निर्माण करलऽ जाय छै ।

नेपाल पछिला तीन दशक मे सड़क पहुँच के विस्तार मे निर्विवाद प्रगति केलक अछि। जे समुदाय कहियो बाजार, स्कूल आ स्वास्थ्य सेवा स दिन दूर छल, आब ओ बस मिनट या घंटा क दूरी पर अछि। मुदा की हम एहन सड़क बना रहल छी जे अपन पूरा जीवन चक्र मे सुरक्षित, कार्यात्मक आ लचीला रहय?

रिबन काटब

सड़क शक्तिशाली चुनावी मुद्रा अछि। कोनो राजनीतिक कार्यकाल के भीतर नव संरेखण के घोषणा, फोटोग्राफी आ उद्घाटन कयल जा सकैत अछि। रखरखाव, जल निकासी, ढलान स्थिरीकरण, आ दीर्घकालिक लचीलापन कम देखाय पड़ैत अछि आ कोनो वोट नहिं. एहि लेल प्रोत्साहन अछि जे जल्दी स निर्माण कैल जाए, पहुंच बढ़ाउल जाए आ तत्काल परिणाम देखाउल जाए। लागत बाद मे अबैत अछि, जखन मानसून ओहि चीज कए उजागर करैत अछि जेकरा डिजाइन आ निर्माण क दौरान अनदेखी कैल गेल छल ।

इंजीनियरिंग मानक एकटा कारण स मौजूद अछि। ढलान काटनाय, संरचना कें बरकरार रखनाय, जल निकासी आ संरेखण कें बारे मे निर्णय कें लेल इलाका, जल विज्ञान आ दीर्घकालिक स्थिरता कें मार्गदर्शन कैल जेबाक चाही. व्यवहार मे ओ निर्णय ठेकेदार, निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि, प्रशासनिक समय सीमा आ खंडित निगरानी कें प्रतिस्पर्धी दबाव सं आकार लैत छै. नगर निगम कें इंजीनियर अक्सर जोखिम कें समझएयत छै, मुदा ओकरा अक्सर बेहतर विकल्पक पर जोर देवय कें लेल संस्थागत अधिकार या समर्थन कें कमी होयत छै.

दक्षिणी ललितपुर मे खराब इंजीनियरिंग वाला हाईवे के निशान ढलान। फोटो : कुण्डा दीक्षित

बाद म॑ जेकरा क॑ तकनीकी विफलता के रूप म॑ वर्णित करलऽ जाय छै, वू लगभग हमेशा सबसें पहल॑ शासन केरऽ विफलता होय छै । सड़क क सतह पर दरार देखबा मे अबैत अछि, मुदा खरीद क फैसला, डिजाइन क समझौता, कमजोर निगरानी आ अस्पष्ट जवाबदेही स इ समस्या बहुत पहिने शुरू भ जाइत अछि।

खरीद संशोधन कें मिलान स्थल आकलन सं ल क मानसून कें बाद कें समीक्षा तइक हर परियोजना कें पूरा जीवन चक्र कें माध्यम सं मजबूत परियोजना तैयारी, स्वतंत्र पर्यवेक्षण आ स्पष्ट जवाबदेही सं करनाय आवश्यक छै. बिना एहि नींव कए ठीक केने बोली क फार्मूला बदलला स अलग नियम क तहत एकहि सड़क क उत्पादन क खतरा अछि।

नगर वित्त अधिकारी एहि चक्र कए नीक स जनैत छथि। मानसून मे सड़क खराब भ जाइत अछि। आपातकालीन मरम्मत मे बजट कें खपत होयत छै जे उचित योजना या बेसि लचीला निर्माण कें वित्तपोषण कयर सकय छै. नगरपालिका सब अंततः ओही बुनियादी ढांचा के निर्माण, मरम्मत आ पुनर्निर्माण करैत अछि जखन कि अंतर्निहित प्रोत्साहन अपरिवर्तित रहैत अछि ।

संघीय पुनर्गठन के कारण जवाबदेही आओर जटिल भ गेल अछि. बहुत सं स्थानीय सड़कक कें वित्तपोषण प्रांतीय या संघीय स्रोत सं कैल जायत छै, नगरपालिकाक कें द्वारा लागू कैल जायत छै, अनेक एजेंसीक कें देखरेख मे आ राजनीतिक नेटवर्क कें पार संचालित ठेकेदारक कें द्वारा निर्मित कैल जायत छै.

जखन कोनो सड़क खराब भ जाइत अछि त जिम्मेदारी विसरल भ जाइत अछि। नगरपालिका ठेकेदार दिस इशारा करैत अछि। ठेकेदार डिजाइन दिस इशारा करैत अछि। फंडिंग एजेंसी कार्यान्वयन दिस इशारा करैत अछि। जे समुदाय प्रत्यक्ष लागत उठाबै छै, ओकरा क्षतिग्रस्त बुनियादी ढाँचा आरू कम सहारा के साथ रह जाय छै.

प्राकृतिक नहि

पर्यावरणीय परिणाम दुर्घटना नहिं होइत छैक । ढलान कें खराब कटौती, अस्थिर भराई कें कारण डूबनाय, जल निकासी कें अवरुद्ध आ कम आकार कें कलवर्ट कें कारण शुरू भ रहल भूस्खलन कें नियमित रूप सं ‘प्राकृतिक’ आपदाक कें रूप मे मानल जायत छै. ओ सभ नहि अछि, ओ सभ शासनक परिणाम अछि।

जेना-जेना बरखा तेज आ अप्रत्याशित होइत जाइत अछि, हर शॉर्टकट महग होइत जाइत अछि । जे सड़क पुरान बरखा के पैटर्न के तहत बचल भ सकैत छल ओ आब भारी मानसून के घटना के तहत खराब भ सकैत अछि. जे बात खबरऽ म॑ अचानक आपदा के रूप म॑ आबै छै, वू अक्सर बजट बैठक, डिजाइन कार्यालय या चुनाव अभियान म॑ सालऽ पहल॑ करलऽ गेलऽ चुनावऽ के देरी स॑ होय वाला परिणाम होय छै । जलवायु कमजोर सड़क नहि बनबैत अछि। कमजोर निर्णय के उजागर करैत अछि।

नेपालमे सक्षम अभियंता वा तकनीकी ज्ञानक अभाव नहि अछि । एकरा म॑ जे कमी छै, वू छै शासन केरऽ माहौल जहाँ तकनीकी निर्णय, राजकोषीय योजना आरू जलवायु जोखिम अल्पकालिक राजनीतिक प्रोत्साहन स॑ अधिक छै ।

खरीद सुधार जरूरी अछि मुदा अपर्याप्त। एकर मिलान मजबूत परियोजना तैयारी, स्वतंत्र पर्यवेक्षण, सरकार कें सब स्तरक मे स्पष्ट जवाबदेही आ निर्माण शुरू हुअ सं पहिले सार्थक समुदायक कें भागीदारी सं करनाय आवश्यक छै.

सब सं ऊपर जलवायु जोखिम कें एकटा मौलिक डिजाइन आवश्यकता कें रूप मे देखनाय आवश्यक छै, न कि संरेखण कें फैसला भ गेलाक कें बाद जांचल जाय वाला बॉक्स कें रूप मे. नाजुक पहाड़ी इलाका में लचीलापन कोनो वैकल्पिक अपग्रेड नै छै. सार्वजनिक बुनियादी ढाँचा बिल्कुल उपयोगी बनल रहत या नहि एकर शर्त अछि।

जेना-जेना एकटा आओर उपराष्ट्रीय चुनाव चक्र नजदीक आबि रहल अछि, सड़क एक बेर फेर सं भाषण... बैनर आओर बजट के वादा पर हावी होएत. राजनीतिक नेतृत्व के असली परीक्षा आब ई नहिं रहि गेल अछि जे मतदान के दिन सं पहिने कतेक किलोमीटर के उद्घाटन भ जाएत अछि. ई छै कि रिबन काटला के बाद, वोट के गिनती के बाद आरू अगला मानसून के आबै स॑ पहल॑ वू सड़क खड़ा रह॑ छै कि नै ।

सड़क शायदे कखनो खाली बरखा हेबाक कारणे खराब भ जाइत अछि। ई सब असफल होय जाय छै, कैन्हेंकि सालों पहलें के फैसला में वू परिदृश्य के वास्तविकता के अनदेखी होय जाय छेलै, जेकरऽ सेवा ओकरऽ उद्देश्य छेलै ।

Yalung Ri, which rises to 5,630 metres, is seen from base camp in Dolakha district of eastern Nepal, bordering Tibet. (Photo: Michael Wandinger via Wikimedia Commons)

KATHMANDU - ⁠Nepali rescue workers ​have spotted five bodies at a site where ​the same number of ‌climbers went missing last year, officials said on Saturday.

Three foreign climbers — an Italian-Canadian, an Italian and a German — and two Nepali nationals have been missing ​since November last ⁠year after being struck by an avalanche on Yalung Ri.

Two others, an Italian and a French climber, ‌had died at the base camp of the mountain, which rises to 5,630 metres (18,470 feet) in Dolakha district, bordering Tibet.

Thabindra Kumar Kafle of the Gaurishankar Rural Municiplity where the mountain is located, said some workers assigned to look for the bodies by a hiking company spotted them on ​Friday.

“We are trying to reach the site where the bodies were seen but are stuck ​here ‌due to bad weather,” said Phurba Tenjing Sherpa of the hiking company Dreamers’ Destination, which had been ​guiding ⁠the foreign climbers.

Phurba was speaking from Bongar Khola, near the site, where a ⁠helicopter was waiting for the visibility to clear.

“The bodies may have come out after the snow melted,” he said.

It was not immediately ⁠clear if the bodies were those of ​the same climbers who went missing on Yalung Ri last year.

The mountain is in northeastern Nepal’s Rolwaling Valley, where climbers have to ‌contend with routes ⁠that include a mix ​of rock, ice and snow.

तीन विदेशी पर्वतारोही — एक इटालियन-कनाडाई, एक इटालियन आरू एक जर्मन — आरू दू नेपाली नागरिक पिछला ⁠वर्ष नवंबर स॑ यालुंग री प॑ हिमस्खलन के बाद लापता छै ।

तिब्बत के सीमा पर स्थित डोलाखा जिला में ५,६३० मीटर (१८,४७० फीट) तक ऊँच पहाड़ के बेस कैंप में दू अन्य, इटली के आरू फ्रांसीसी पर्वतारोही के मौत होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

पहाड़ स्थित गौरीशंकर ग्रामीण नगरपालिका के थाविन्द्र कुमार काफ्ले कहलनि जे, एकटा पैदल यात्रा कंपनी द्वारा शव के खोजय लेल नियुक्त किछु मजदूर शुक्रदिन शव के देखलनि।

विदेशी पर्वतारोही सब के मार्गदर्शन करय वाला हाइकिंग कंपनी ड्रीमर्स डेस्टिनेशन के फुर्बा तेनजिंग शेर्पा कहलनि जे, हम सब ओहि जगह पर पहुंचबाक कोशिश क रहल छी जतय लाश देखल गेल छल मुदा खराब मौसम के कारण एतय फंसल अछि।

फुर्बा ओहि स्थलक समीप बोंगर खोला सं बाजि रहल छलाह, जतय एकटा ⁠हेलीकॉप्टर दृश्यता साफ हेबाक प्रतीक्षा में छल.

ओ कहलनि जे, बर्फ पिघललाक बाद लाश बाहर आबि गेल होयत।

तत्काल ई साफ नै भेलै कि ई लाश वू ही पर्वतारोही के छेलै जे पिछला साल यालुंग री पर लापता होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

ई पहाड़ नेपालक पूर्वोत्तर रोलवालिंग घाटी में अछि, जतय पर्वतारोही लोकनि कें एहन मार्ग सं जूझय पड़ैत छनि ⁠जाहि में चट्टान, बर्फ आ बर्फक मिश्रण शामिल अछि.

Gandaki has made history by becoming the first province in Nepal to legalise the regulated cultivation and medical use of cannabis. The milestone legislation allows licensed commercial enterprises and local farmers to cultivate cannabis under strict state oversight, establishing a structured framework for a plant that grows naturally across the region’s mountainous terrain.

This decision permits the production of pharmaceuticals, essential oils, and industrial raw materials, provided the harvested crop adheres to an internationally recognised psychoactive threshold capped at 0.3 per cent Tetrahydrocannabinol (THC). Personal recreational use and unregulated home cultivation remain strictly illegal, with mandatory destruction protocols enforced for any non-compliant plant material.

Economic Ambition Meets Federal Friction

For decades, Nepal enforced total prohibition following international pressure in the late 1970s that effectively shut down its famous cannabis tourism. Provincial policymakers now view controlled cultivation as a powerful engine for economic revitalisation. By converting barren or low-productivity land into commercial cultivation zones, the province aims to create rural employment, retain youth talent, and supply high-value industrial and medicinal markets.

However, the policy sets up a notable constitutional friction. While Gandaki’s provincial law authorises commercial permits, Nepal’s national narcotics law continues to criminalise cannabis possession and trade. Reconciling this provincial pioneering effort with national law enforcement will be critical to the regulatory framework’s long-term stability.

Regulatory Guardrails for Cultivators

To prevent illicit diversion and ensure strict quality control, the new provincial act imposes stringent operational requirements:

Minimum Scale Limits: Cultivation licences are granted exclusively to registered corporate entities or farms operating on at least two ropanis of land.

Guaranteed Off-Take Contracts: Applicants must submit formal supply agreements with registered pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturers before securing final approval.

Designated Cultivation Zones: Commercial farming is restricted to specific geographic zones selected for soil suitability, security monitoring, and ease of oversight.

Cross-Border Implications with Bihar

The geographical dimension of this policy shift carries significant regional interest, particularly given Gandaki’s southern border connection with India’s Bihar state via the Valmikinagar border in West Champaran.

With Bihar maintaining strict prohibition on alcohol, cross-border security agencies actively monitor contraband movement along the border. Although Gandaki’s law is strictly tailored for processed pharmaceutical ingredients and industrial hemp, law enforcement mechanisms on both sides of the open border will likely enhance vigilance to prevent supply leakages into black markets.

गण्डकी नेपालक पहिल प्रदेश बनि इतिहास रचलनि अछि जे भांगक विनियमित खेती आ चिकित्सा उपयोग केँ वैध बना देलक अछि । मील के पत्थर कानून लाइसेंस प्राप्त वाणिज्यिक उद्यम आ स्थानीय किसानक कें सख्त राज्य निगरानी मे भांग कें खेती करय कें अनुमति देयत छै, जे एकटा पौधा कें लेल संरचित रूपरेखा स्थापित करयत छै जे क्षेत्र कें पहाड़ी इलाका मे प्राकृतिक रूप सं उगय छै.

इ निर्णय दवाइयक, आवश्यक तेल, आ औद्योगिक कच्चा माल कें उत्पादन कें अनुमति देयत छै, बशर्ते कि काटल गेल फसल 0.3 प्रतिशत टेट्राहाइड्रोकैनाबिनोल (टीएचसी) कें सीमाबद्ध अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर मान्यता प्राप्त मनोसक्रिय सीमा कें पालन करय. व्यक्तिगत मनोरंजन उपयोग आ अनियमित घरक खेती सख्ती सं गैरकानूनी बनल छै, जइ मे कोनों गैर-अनुरूप पौधा सामग्री कें लेल अनिवार्य विनाश प्रोटोकॉल लागू कैल गेल छै.

आर्थिक महत्वाकांक्षा संघीय घर्षण से मिलता

How the removal of a Muslim flag from the minaret of a mosque and the playing of loud DJ music in front of a mosque escalated into multi-district unrest, prompting curfews, paramilitary and army deployment and a renewed debate over Hindu nationalism and state capacity.

By Syed Khalique Ahmed

NEW DELHI: The outbreak of Hindu–Muslim violence in Nepal’s Madhesi–Tarai region between 26 and 29 July 2026 has triggered intense debate over both the scale of the unrest and the adequacy of the government’s response. While sections of the Nepali media criticised the administration headed by Prime Minister Balendra Shah for allegedly acting too slowly during the initial phase of the disturbances, reports from international media and security sources suggest that the state eventually adopted a firm, multi-layered security response that succeeded in restoring order across the affected districts.

Security Response: From Police Deployment to Army Support

According to available reports, the authorities first relied on the Nepal Police to disperse crowds, separate rival groups, and prevent the violence from spreading. As clashes intensified, district administrations imposed indefinite curfews in several sensitive areas. Notably, these curfews remained in force even after active street confrontations had subsided, indicating official concern about renewed mobilisation and retaliatory violence.

When local police proved insufficient to contain the unrest, the government deployed the Armed Police Force (APF), Nepal’s paramilitary force responsible for riot control, counter-insurgency support, and border security operations. Subsequently, as mobs reportedly continued to defy curfew orders, units of the Nepali Army were called in to assist civil authorities. Army personnel, supported by armoured vehicles, were deployed in key urban centres to enforce curfew restrictions, protect public and private property, and deter further rioting.

Police reportedly issued repeated warnings before opening fire on violent crowds. Three men were killed in police firing—two in Sunsari district and one in Siraha district. Government sources maintain that the firing occurred after mobs refused to disperse despite repeated warnings and continued engaging in violent attacks. The deceased have been identified as: Ganesh Yadav (17), Jaya Prakash Mehta (20) and Om Prakash Mehta (24). Political and Humanitarian Measures

In addition to security measures, Prime Minister Balendra Shah addressed the nation through state-run television, appealing for calm and assuring citizens that the government would conduct a fair, impartial, and transparent investigation into the violence and hold those responsible accountable. MP also said that Nepal was a secular state and people, irrespective of their faith, have a right to live without fear. Indian constitutional authorities, who frequently use divisive language and targetting minority communities, particularly Muslims, need to learn from the Nepali PM.

Home Minister Sudan Gurung visited the families of the three men killed in police firing and announced financial compensation for them. However, the government has not yet announced a comprehensive compensation or reconstruction package for damaged Muslim properties, including mosques, madrasas, shops, and homes.

Why the Violence Was Unusual

Nepal has experienced localised Hindu–Muslim tensions in the past, particularly in parts of the Madhes/Tarai belt, but previous incidents were generally confined to specific localities, and rarely spread across multiple districts. Attacks on religious institutions had also been comparatively uncommon.

For this reason, the geographical spread and intensity of the July 2026 violence came as a shock to many observers. What began on the evening of 26 July in Kaptanganj, Sunsari district, reportedly spread within days to at least six additional districts, including: Kailali, Janakpur, Dhanusha, Morang, Koshi and Mahottari.

These districts contain a significant proportion of Nepal’s Muslim population.

Media reports indicate that mosques, madrasas, Muslim-owned shops, houses, and other properties were among the principal targets of the attacks. Particularly serious allegations emerged from Mahottari district, where Madrasa Islamia Faize Millat was reportedly vandalised, with religious books, including copies of the Quran, allegedly desecrated.

Immediate Trigger: Mosque Flag Dispute and Religious Procession

The immediate trigger for the violence is reported to have been a dispute involving a green Islamic flag that had been removed from the minaret of a mosque and allegedly replaced with a saffron Hindu flag. A complaint was reportedly filed with the local police.

Tensions escalated when a Hindu religious procession passed near the mosque during Muslim prayer time. According to local accounts, the procession used loud DJ music, and members of the Muslim community requested that the music be stopped while prayers were underway. The processionists allegedly refused, leading to a confrontation that quickly escalated into wider communal clashes and spread across multiple locations in the Madhesi–Tarai region along the Indo–Nepal border.

Demographic Context

According to Nepal’s 2021 Census, Muslims constitute 5.09% of the population, numbering approximately 1.48 million (14.8 lakhs) out of a total population of about 29.2 million(2.92 crores). They are concentrated mainly in Madhesh and Lumbini provinces.

The capital Kathmandu has a Muslim population of 26,339, or roughly 1.29% of the city’s population. Kathmandu is also home to the historic Kashmiri Masjid, regarded as the city’s oldest mosque, originally established by Kashmiri Muslim traders during Nepal’s Malla dynasty.

Allegations Against Hindu Swayamsevak Sangh (HSS) Nepal

A major and politically sensitive dimension of the controversy concerns allegations against Hindu Swayamsevak Sangh (HSS) Nepal. Investigative journalists and civil society groups have alleged that individuals associated with HSS played a role in escalating communal tensions during the July violence.

Publications such as Himal Khabar have reported that persons linked to HSS Nepal allegedly used social media platforms to circulate provocative messages, inflame religious sentiments, and mobilise crowds. Some reports further alleged that mobs chanting Hindu nationalist slogans continued demonstrations even after curfew orders had been imposed. But these allegations are only matters of media reporting and political debate.

HSS Nepal: Organisation and Influence

HSS Nepal was established in the early 1990s by Nepali students who had studied in India. Its headquarters, including facilities such as Keshav Dham in Kathmandu, are operated by Nepali members and volunteers (swayamsevaks).

The organisation is considered to have its strongest presence in the southern Tarai plains bordering India, particularly among sections of the Madhesi Hindu population, whose communities share deep linguistic, cultural, and familial ties with neighbouring Indian states such as Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. Although its principal base is in the Tarai, HSS maintains networks in all seven provinces of Nepal, including the hill regions.

The Broader Debate: Secularism versus Hindu State

The violence has revived Nepal’s long-running debate over national identity and secularism.

Nepal remained a Hindu kingdom under the Shah dynasty for centuries until 28 May 2008, when the Constituent Assembly abolished the monarchy and declared the country the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal. The new constitutional framework removed Hinduism’s status as the state religion and established Nepal as a secular republic.

Since then, several political forces have advocated restoring Nepal as a Hindu state, most prominently the Rashtriya Prajatantra Party (RPP).

A November 2024 report by the Center for the Study of Organised Hate (CSOH) argued that the rise of Hindu nationalism in India has influenced parallel political currents in Nepal. According to the report, the RPP submitted a 40-point memorandum to the Nepali Prime Minister in February 2024 demanding that Nepal be declared a Hindu kingdom with the monarchy as its guardian.

The CSOH report further alleged that the ideological influence of India’s Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and its parent organisation, the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS), has strengthened campaigns advocating the restoration of a Hindu state in Nepal.

The report also cited earlier political statements by Indian leaders, including Yogi Adityanath, who wrote a letter urging Nepal in 2015 to declare itself a ‘‘Hindu nation”, and BJP spokesperson Vijay Sonkar Shastri, who in 2021 publicly stated that Nepal was and would remain a Hindu kingdom.

Competing Interpretations

Analysts remain divided over the government’s handling of the crisis.

One view holds that the administration was initially hesitant, possibly because some political actors were perceived as sympathetic to Hindu nationalist groups. Another interpretation is that the authorities deliberately attempted a graduated response, beginning with civilian policing and escalating to paramilitary and military deployment only after it became clear that the unrest was spreading across district boundaries and threatened broader regional stability.

The available evidence suggests that while the state may have underestimated the speed and scale of the mobilisation during the first 24–48 hours, it ultimately employed substantial coercive capacity—including curfews, paramilitary deployment, army support, and the use of live fire—to restore order.

Unresolved Questions

The July 2026 Madhesi–Tarai violence represents one of the most serious episodes of communal unrest in Nepal’s recent history. Its significance lies not only in the number of districts affected and the targeting of religious institutions, but also in the way it has become connected with larger debates about secularism, Hindu nationalism, cross-border ideological influence, minority security, and state capacity.

Several crucial questions remain unresolved: Who organised and coordinated the violence? Were social media networks systematically used to mobilise attacks? Did security agencies respond with sufficient speed during the initial phase? Will the promised investigation be genuinely independent and transparent? How will the state address the grievances of affected Muslim communities, particularly regarding compensation and reconstruction?

The answers to these questions are necessary to the future of secular democracy in Nepal.

सुरक्षा प्रतिक्रिया : पुलिस तैनाती स ल कए सेना क समर्थन तक

उपलब्ध रिपोर्ट के अनुसार अधिकारि सब पहिने नेपाल पुलिस पर निर्भर छल जे भीड़ के तितर-बितर करय, प्रतिद्वंद्वी समूह के अलग करय, आ हिंसा के प्रसार नहि करय. झड़प तेज होइते जिला प्रशासन कईटा संवेदनशील इलाका मे अनिश्चितकालीन कर्फ्यू लगा देलक। उल्लेखनीय छै कि ई कर्फ्यू सक्रिय सड़क मुठभेड़ कम होय के बाद भी लागू रहलै, जे नयऽ जुटान आरू प्रतिशोधी हिंसा के बारे म॑ आधिकारिक चिंता के संकेत दै छै ।

जखन स्थानीय पुलिस अशांति के रोकय लेल अपर्याप्त साबित भेल त सरकार नेपाल के अर्धसैनिक बल सशस्त्र पुलिस बल (एपीएफ) के तैनात क देलक जे दंगा नियंत्रण, विद्रोह विरोधी समर्थन, आ सीमा सुरक्षा अभियान के जिम्मेदार छल. एकर बाद भीड़ कर्फ्यू के आदेश के अवहेलना करैत रहला के बाद नागरिक प्राधिकरण के सहायता के लेल नेपाली सेना के यूनिट के बजाओल गेल। बख्तरबंद गाड़ी के सहयोग स॑ सेना केरऽ जवानऽ क॑ प्रमुख शहरी केंद्रऽ म॑ तैनात करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ताकि कर्फ्यू प्रतिबंध लागू करलऽ जाय सक॑, सार्वजनिक आरू निजी संपत्ति के सुरक्षा करलऽ जाय सक॑ आरू आगू के दंगा क॑ रोकलऽ जाय सक॑ ।

बताओल जा रहल अछि जे पुलिस हिंसक भीड़ पर गोलीबारी करबा स पहिने बेर-बेर चेतावनी जारी केलक। पुलिसक गोलीबारी मे तीन गोटेक मौत भ गेल-सुनसरी जिला मे दू गोटे आ सिराहा जिला मे एकटा। सरकारी सूत्रऽ के कहना छै कि बार-बार चेतावनी के बावजूद भीड़ न॑ तितर-बितर होय स॑ मना करी क॑ हिंसक हमला जारी रखला के बाद गोलीबारी करलऽ गेलऽ छै । मृतक के पहचान : गणेश यादव (17), जय प्रकाश मेहता (20) आ ओम प्रकाश मेहता (24) के रूप मे कायल गेल अछि। राजनीतिक एवं मानवीय उपाय

गृहमंत्री सूडान गुरुंग पुलिस गोलीबारी मे मारल गेल तीनू लोकक परिवार सं भेंट केलनि आ हुनका सभ के आर्थिक मुआवजा देबाक घोषणा केलनि। लेकिन सरकार अखनी तलक मस्जिद, मदरसा, दुकान, आरू घर सहित क्षतिग्रस्त मुस्लिम संपत्ति के व्यापक मुआवजा या पुनर्निर्माण पैकेज के घोषणा नै करलकै ।

ई कारण स॑ जुलाई २०२६ केरऽ हिंसा केरऽ भौगोलिक प्रसार आरू तीव्रता बहुत पर्यवेक्षकऽ लेली झटका के रूप म॑ सामने ऐलै । सुनसरी जिला के कप्तानगंज मे जे 26 जुलाई के साँझ मे शुरू भेल छल ओ किछुए दिन मे कम सं कम छह अतिरिक्त जिला मे पसरल बताओल जा रहल अछि जाहि मे: कैलाली, जनकपुर, धनुषा, मोरंग, कोशी आ महोत्तरी शामिल अछि.

एहि जिला सभ मे नेपालक मुस्लिम आबादी केर एकटा महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा अछि |

तत्काल ट्रिगर : मस्जिद के झंडा विवाद एवं धार्मिक जुलूस

खबर छै कि हिंसा केरऽ तत्काल ट्रिगर एगो विवाद छेलै जेकरा म॑ एगो हरियर इस्लामी झंडा शामिल छेलै जेकरा एगो मस्जिद केरऽ मीनार स॑ हटाय क॑ कथित तौर प॑ केसर केरऽ हिन्दू झंडा लगाय देलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । बताओल जा रहल अछि जे स्थानीय पुलिस मे शिकायत दर्ज कराओल गेल।

मुस्लिम नमाज के समय मस्जिद के पास हिन्दू धार्मिक जुलूस गुजरला पर तनाव बढ़ी गेलै । स्थानीय विवरण के अनुसार जुलूस में जोरदार डीजे संगीत के प्रयोग भेल, आ मुस्लिम समुदाय के सदस्य सब के आग्रह छल जे नमाज के दौरान संगीत बंद क देल जाय। जुलूसबाज कथित तौर पर मना क देलक, जाहि स टकराव जल्दीए व्यापक साम्प्रदायिक झड़प मे बदलि गेल आ भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर मधेसी-तराई क्षेत्र मे अनेक स्थान पर पसरल।

जनसांख्यिकीय संदर्भ

नेपाल केरऽ २०२१ केरऽ जनगणना के अनुसार मुसलमानऽ के संख्या ५.०९% छै, जेकरऽ संख्या लगभग २.९.२ मिलियन(२.९२ करोड़) के कुल जनसंख्या म॑ लगभग १४.८ लाख (१४.८ लाख) छै । ई सब मुख्यतः मधेश आ लुम्बिनी प्रांत मे केन्द्रित अछि ।

हिन्दू स्वयंसेवक संघ (एचएसएस) नेपाल के विरुद्ध आरोप

विवाद केरऽ एगो प्रमुख आरू राजनीतिक रूप स॑ संवेदनशील आयाम हिन्दू स्वयंसेवक संघ (एचएसएस) नेपाल प॑ लगलऽ आरोपऽ स॑ संबंधित छै । जांच पत्रकार आरू नागरिक समाज के समूह के आरोप छै कि जुलाई म॑ भेलऽ हिंसा के दौरान साम्प्रदायिक तनाव बढ़ाबै म॑ एचएसएस स॑ जुड़लऽ व्यक्ति के भूमिका छेलै ।

हिमल खबर जैसनऽ प्रकाशनऽ म॑ एचएसएस नेपाल स॑ जुड़लऽ व्यक्ति न॑ कथित तौर प॑ सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ भड़काऊ संदेश फैलाबै, धार्मिक भावना क॑ भड़काबै, भीड़ क॑ जुटाबै के खबर देल॑ छै । कुछ रिपोर्ट म॑ आरू आरोप लगैलऽ गेलऽ छै कि हिन्दू राष्ट्रवादी नारा लगाबै वाला भीड़ न॑ कर्फ्यू के आदेश लगला के बाद भी प्रदर्शन जारी रखलकै । मुदा ई आरोप मात्र मीडिया रिपोर्टिंग आओर राजनीतिक बहस के मामला अछि.

एचएसएस नेपाल : संगठन एवं प्रभाव

एचएसएस नेपाल के स्थापना 1990 के दशक के प्रारंभ में भारत में पढ़ल नेपाली छात्र द्वारा कयल गेल छल | काठमांडू के केशव धाम जेहन सुविधा सहित एकर मुख्यालय नेपाली सदस्य आ स्वयंसेवक (स्वयंसेवक) द्वारा संचालित अछि ।

ई संगठन केरऽ सबसें मजबूत उपस्थिति भारत के सीमा स॑ सटलऽ दक्षिणी तराई मैदानऽ म॑ खास करी क॑ मधेसी हिन्दू आबादी केरऽ कुछ वर्गऽ के बीच मानलऽ जाय छै, जेकरऽ समुदायऽ के पड़ोसी भारतीय राज्य जेना कि बिहार आरू उत्तर प्रदेश स॑ गहरा भाषाई, सांस्कृतिक, आरू पारिवारिक संबंध छै । यद्यपि एकरऽ प्रमुख आधार तराई म॑ छै, लेकिन एचएसएस नेपाल केरऽ सब सात प्रांत म॑ जाल बनाबै छै, जेकरा म॑ पहाड़ी क्षेत्र भी शामिल छै ।

व्यापक बहस : धर्मनिरपेक्षता बनाम हिन्दू राज्य

एहि हिंसा स नेपाल मे राष्ट्रीय पहिचान आ धर्मनिरपेक्षता पर चलि रहल बहस फेर स जीवित भ गेल अछि।

नेपाल २८ मई २००८ धरि शाह वंशक अन्तर्गत हिन्दू राज्य रहल, जखन संविधानसभा राजतंत्रकेँ समाप्त कए देशकेँ संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणराज्य नेपाल घोषित कए देलक । नव संवैधानिक रूपरेखा हिन्दू धर्म के राज्य धर्म के दर्जा हटा देलक आ नेपाल के धर्मनिरपेक्ष गणतंत्र के रूप में स्थापित केलक |

तहिया सँ कतेको राजनीतिक शक्ति नेपाल केँ हिन्दू राज्यक रूप मे पुनर्स्थापित करबाक वकालत केलक अछि, जाहि मे सबसँ प्रमुख अछि राष्ट्रीय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी (आरपीपी) ।

संगठित नफरत के अध्ययन केंद्र (CSOH) के नवम्बर 2024 के रिपोर्ट में भारत में हिन्दू राष्ट्रवाद के उदय नेपाल के समानांतर राजनीतिक धारा के प्रभावित केलक अछि, ई तर्क देल गेल छल । रिपोर्ट के अनुसार आरपीपी फरवरी 2024 मे नेपाली प्रधानमंत्री के 40 सूत्री ज्ञापन सौंपने छल जाहि मे नेपाल के राजतंत्र के रक्षक बना क हिन्दू राज्य घोषित करबाक मांग केने छल।

सीएसओएच केरऽ रिपोर्ट म॑ आगू आरोप लगैलऽ गेलऽ छै कि भारत केरऽ भारतीय जनता पार्टी आरू ओकरऽ मूल संगठन राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ केरऽ वैचारिक प्रभाव न॑ नेपाल म॑ हिन्दू राज्य केरऽ बहाली के वकालत करै वाला अभियान क॑ मजबूत करी देल॑ छै ।

रिपोर्ट म॑ भारतीय नेता सिनी केरऽ पहलऽ राजनीतिक बयान के हवाला भी देलऽ गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ २०१५ म॑ नेपाल क॑ ‘‘हिन्दू राष्ट्र’ घोषित करै के आग्रह करै वाला पत्र लिखै वाला योगी आदित्यनाथ आरू २०२१ म॑ सार्वजनिक रूप स॑ कहलकै कि नेपाल हिन्दू राज्य छेकै आरू रहतै ।

प्रतिस्पर्धी व्याख्याएँ

सरकार के तरफ सं संकट के निपटारा पर विश्लेषक मे विभाजन बनल अछि.

एक विचार के अनुसार प्रशासन शुरू में संकोच करलकै, संभवतः ई लेली कि कुछ राजनीतिक अभिनेता क॑ हिन्दू राष्ट्रवादी समूहऽ के प्रति सहानुभूति वाला मानलऽ जाय छेलै । एकरऽ एगो आरू व्याख्या ई छै कि अधिकारियऽ न॑ जानबूझ क॑ स्नातक प्रतिक्रिया के कोशिश करलकै, जेकरऽ शुरुआत सिविल पुलिसिंग स॑ करलऽ गेलै आरू अर्धसैनिक आरू सैन्य तैनाती तलक पहुँची क॑ ई बात साफ होय गेलै कि ई बात साफ होय गेलै कि ई अशांति जिला सीमा के पार फैललऽ छै आरू व्यापक क्षेत्रीय स्थिरता प॑ खतरा मंडरा रहलऽ छै ।

उपलब्ध सबूतऽ स॑ पता चलै छै कि राज्य न॑ पहलऽ २४-४८ घंटा के दौरान जुटान के गति आरू पैमाना क॑ कम आंकल॑ हुअ॑ सकै छै, लेकिन अंततः ओकरा न॑ व्यवस्था बहाल करै लेली पर्याप्त जबरदस्ती क्षमता के प्रयोग करलकै-जइ म॑ कर्फ्यू, अर्धसैनिक तैनाती, सेना केरऽ समर्थन, आरू जीवित फायरिंग के उपयोग भी शामिल छेलै ।

अनसुलझल प्रश्न

जुलाई २०२६ मे भेल मधेसी–तराई हिंसा नेपालक हालक इतिहास मे साम्प्रदायिक अशांतिक सबसँ गंभीर प्रकरण मे सँ एक के प्रतिनिधित्व करैत अछि । एकरऽ महत्व खाली प्रभावित जिला के संख्या आरू धार्मिक संस्थानऽ क॑ लक्षित करै म॑ ही नै छै, बल्कि एकरा धर्मनिरपेक्षता, हिन्दू राष्ट्रवाद, सीमा पार स॑ वैचारिक प्रभाव, अल्पसंख्यक सुरक्षा, आरू राज्य क्षमता के बारे म॑ बड़ऽ बहस स॑ जुड़लऽ होय के तरीका म॑ भी छै ।

कईटा महत्वपूर्ण सवाल अनसुलझल अछि जे हिंसा क आयोजन आ समन्वय के केलक? की सोशल मीडिया नेटवर्क के व्यवस्थित रूप सं उपयोग हमला के जुटान करय लेल कएल गेल छल? की सुरक्षा एजेंसी प्रारंभिक चरण मे पर्याप्त गति सं जवाब देलक? की वादा कएल गेल जांच सही मायने मे स्वतंत्र आ पारदर्शी होयत? राज्य प्रभावित मुस्लिम समुदायक कें शिकायत कें कोना संबोधित करतय, खासकर मुआवजा आ पुनर्निर्माण कें संबंध मे?

एहि सब प्रश्नक उत्तर नेपाल मे धर्मनिरपेक्ष लोकतंत्रक भविष्य लेल आवश्यक अछि ।

title: Nepal rescuers find bodies of five climbers killed last year - Arab News PK
description: Nepal rescuers find bodies of five climbers killed last year  Arab News PK
publisher.title: Arab News PK
full_article:
Katmandu: Rescuers in Nepal have found the bodies of five mountaineers, including three foreigners, killed in an avalanche last year near the Chinese border, a local government official said Saturday.

“Five bodies, three foreigners and two Nepalis, who had been missing since last November, have been discovered,” said Biswash Karki, chairman of Gaurishankar Rural Municipality.

The foreigners were an Italian-Canadian, a German and an Italian, he told AFP.

The avalanche hit the climbers on the lower flanks of the 5,630-meter (18,471-foot) Yalung Ri peak, near Nepal’s border with Tibet.

Locals and rescuers discovered the bodies on Thursday, Karki said, adding that the local authority was working to recover them.

“Ever since they went missing, we had been deploying the army, police and local rescue teams to search for them, but thick snow had covered their bodies,” the official said.

Senior local police officer Manoj Kumar Lama said a rescue helicopter was sent to the area on Friday, but “due to bad weather, our team has not been able to reach the spot.”

“Our rescue team will airlift the bodies once the weather clears,” he told AFP.

Home to eight of the world’s 10 highest peaks, including Mount Everest, Nepal welcomes hundreds of climbers and trekkers every year.

According to the Himalayan Database, an expedition archive, more than 1,000 people have died on peaks since 1950, with avalanches killing almost a third of them.

title: U.S. Deportation Flights to Nepal Halt During Middle East War; 5 Nepalis Deported in July - nepyork
description: U.S. Deportation Flights to Nepal Halt During Middle East War; 5 Nepalis Deported in July  nepyork

full_article:
NEW YORK — The number of Nepali nationals deported from the United States fell sharply in July, with only five people returned to Nepal — the lowest monthly total this year — according to Nepal’s Department of Immigration.

Four men and one woman were deported in July. The department said the United States has not deported anyone to Nepal on a charter flight since the first week of April, when the last such flight arrived in Kathmandu. The pause has occurred during the war in the Middle East, although it remains unclear whether the conflict is responsible for the suspension.

The department noted that it has not confirmed whether the Middle East conflict directly caused the decline in deportations. Nine Nepali nationals were deported in June.

While deportation numbers have temporarily declined, immigration experts say the risk of removal remains significant.

The second Trump administration, which began Jan. 20, 2025, has adopted stricter immigration enforcement policies. Federal agencies, including U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), have prioritized the deportation of individuals with final removal orders, visa overstays, and denied asylum claims.

Large numbers of Nepalis were deported on charter flights during the early months of 2026. In January alone, 101 Nepalis were deported, including 80 people — 79 men and one woman — who arrived in Kathmandu on a single charter flight. The trend continued in February, when 95 Nepalis were deported via charter flight, followed by 43 deportations in March.

In early April, U.S. authorities returned 45 Nepalis to Kathmandu on a single charter flight, creating widespread fear within the Nepali community. The pattern shifted in May, when no charter flights were used and 15 people were returned on regular commercial flights.

Deportation flights to remove undocumented immigrants. (DHS photo by ICE/released)

According to official data, most recently deported Nepalis were from the western districts of Dang, Rukum, Salyan, and Banke. Many initially entered the United States without valid visas.

The number of deportations rose sharply in late 2025 after Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Nepal ended. Eighty Nepalis were deported in November 2025, and 98 were deported in December. On a single day in December, the United States deported 75 Nepalis — 69 men and six women.

Department of Immigration data show that deportations fluctuated substantially throughout 2025. The monthly totals were six in January, 18 in February, 32 in March, 26 in April, 58 in May, 42 in June, 17 in July, 16 in August, 53 in September, and 38 in October.

Courts Issued 1,162 Removal Orders in 18 Months

Data from the Executive Office for Immigration Review (EOIR), compiled by Syracuse University’s Transactional Records Access Clearinghouse (TRAC), show that U.S. immigration courts issued removal orders against 1,162 Nepali nationals from January 2025 through June 2026.

That total represents 25% of all removal orders issued against Nepalis over the past 28 years.

Combined, the first Trump administration and the current administration have generated 2,006 removal orders involving Nepali nationals. That accounts for 43.24% of the 4,639 removal orders recorded since 1998.

During fiscal year 2025 and the first nine months of fiscal year 2026, removal orders were the most common outcome in cases involving Nepali nationals, surpassing grants of legal protection and case dismissals.

In fiscal year 2025, immigration courts completed 1,837 cases involving Nepali nationals. Judges issued removal orders in 569 cases and granted legal protection in 378 cases (20.58% of all completed cases). Courts dismissed 249 cases, while 223 cases were recorded as having no Notice to Appear (NTA) filed.

U.S. Immigration Court (Photo: EOIR)

Other outcomes included 185 cases in which credible fear was not established, 94 cases in which credible fear was established, 87 cases in which voluntary departure was granted, and 23 cases closed through other means. Smaller categories included 13 other credible-fear decisions, 11 other withholding-only decisions, two cases involving prosecutorial discretion, two other asylum-only decisions, and one withholding-only denial.

Removal orders constituted the largest category of outcomes in fiscal year 2025, followed by legal protection and case dismissals. The protection rate represented slightly more than one-fifth of all outcomes (20.58%) and 39.92% of decisions issued directly on the merits.

During the first nine months of fiscal year 2026, immigration courts completed 941 cases involving Nepali nationals. Judges issued 634 removal orders, dismissed 88 cases, granted voluntary departure in 73 cases, and granted legal protection in only 72 cases (7.65% of all completed cases).

Other outcomes included 30 cases in which credible fear was not established, 29 cases without an NTA filed, six cases closed through other means, five cases in which credible fear was established, three other credible-fear decisions, and one asylum-only case in which protection was denied.

The fiscal year 2026 data indicate that the rate of removal orders has increased sharply compared with 2025. Removal orders represent a clear majority of completed cases, while the share of individuals granted legal protection declined to 7.65% of overall cases and 10.20% of decisions made directly on the merits.

Sharp Increase in Removal Orders

TRAC data based on EOIR records show a steep increase in removal orders issued against Nepali nationals during fiscal years 2025 and 2026.

From January 2025 through June 2026, immigration judges issued 1,162 removal orders against Nepalis, accounting for more than one-quarter of the total recorded over 28 years. This figure is significantly higher than totals recorded during the Biden administration and Trump’s first term.

In 2025 alone, judges issued 783 removal orders against Nepali nationals. The monthly total rose from 26 in January to a peak of 112 in October. During the first six months of 2026, immigration judges issued another 379 removal orders, maintaining a monthly average of about 63.

By comparison, during the Biden administration (January 2021 through December 2024), judges issued 644 removal orders involving Nepali nationals. During Trump’s first term (January 2017 through December 2020), judges issued 864 such orders.

The 783 removal orders issued in 2025 alone exceeded the total issued across the entire four-year Biden administration.

Deported Nepali nationals arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. Photo: Gopal Dahal/RSS

Legal Protection Declines

Over the long term, the number of Nepali nationals granted legal protection has fluctuated significantly and has declined sharply in recent years.

Immigration courts granted legal protection in a record 720 cases involving Nepalis in 2023. The annual total declined to 607 in 2024, 378 in 2025, and only 72 during the first six months of 2026.

While removal orders surged in 2025 and 2026, grants of legal protection fell substantially below 2023 levels.

Historically, legal-protection grants numbered 14 in 1998, 35 in 2001, 41 in 2002, 65 in 2003, 103 in 2004, and 96 in 2005. The figure rose to 180 in 2006 and 189 in 2009, before climbing to 251 in 2010, 343 in 2011, 436 in 2012, and 445 in 2013.

The annual total remained near 300 through the mid-2010s before peaking in 2023.

Removal-order totals have also expanded when viewed by fiscal year. Courts issued 569 removal orders in fiscal year 2025 and 634 in fiscal year 2026 — both well above previous peaks of 349 in fiscal year 2019, 237 in 2011, 218 in 2018, and 204 in 2023.

Removal orders involving Nepali nationals were comparatively low in the late 1990s and early 2000s: 28 in 1998, 42 in 1999, 50 in 2000, 31 in 2001, 34 in 2002, 49 in 2003, and 66 in 2004. The figure then rose to 94 in 2005, 95 in 2006, 88 in 2007, and 100 in 2008.

During the 2010s, removal orders grew to 122 in 2009, 129 in 2010, 237 in 2011, 180 in 2012, 183 in 2013, 187 in 2014, 127 in 2015, 107 in 2016, 139 in 2017, 218 in 2018, and 349 in 2019.

The total fell to 170 in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and dropped to 48 in 2021 before climbing to 163 in 2022, 204 in 2023, and 196 in 2024. It then surged in 2025 and 2026.

The 783 removal orders issued in 2025 were more than four times the 2024 total and more than double the combined totals of 2021 and 2022.

ICE Arrested 388 Nepalis in 13 Months

During the Trump administration’s first 13 months, ICE arrested 388 Nepali nationals in the United States, including 124 individuals who either faced criminal charges or had prior criminal convictions, according to ICE data compiled and processed by the Deportation Data Project.

From February 2025 through February 2026, only 31.9% of Nepalis arrested by ICE had pending criminal charges or prior convictions. The remaining 264 people were accused solely of immigration enforcement violations.

Internal ICE records indicate that of the 124 individuals with criminal records or pending charges, 53 had prior convictions and 71 faced pending charges.

While the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has stated that roughly 70% of individuals arrested nationwide by ICE have pending criminal charges or prior convictions, data involving Nepali nationals present a markedly different pattern: fewer than one in three Nepalis arrested by ICE had a recorded criminal conviction or pending criminal case at the time of arrest.

ICE Philadelphia conducted a worksite enforcement operation at a Philadelphia car wash on January 28, arresting seven undocumented immigrants.

Monthly arrests of Nepali nationals fluctuated but never reached the 70% criminal threshold cited by DHS. In 2025, ICE arrested 29 Nepalis in February, 15 in March, five in April, 27 in May, 39 in June, 27 in July, 35 in August, 35 in September, 38 in October, 48 in November, and 42 in December.

ICE arrested 29 Nepalis in January 2026 and 19 in February 2026.

Men made up the vast majority of those arrested: 370 men, 17 women, and one person listed as “unknown.” Of the 388 Nepalis arrested, 174 had final removal orders, 195 did not yet have final orders, and the legal status of 19 was unspecified.

ICE has deported 156 of these 388 individuals to Nepal. They are among nearly 800 Nepalis deported from the United States since January 2025.

A separate nationwide TRAC study found that as of July 11, 2026, 46,436 of the 65,765 immigrants held in ICE detention nationwide (70.65%) had no criminal convictions. Among those with convictions, many involved minor infractions, such as traffic violations.

Of all individuals in ICE custody, 58,231 (89%) were arrested directly by ICE, while 7,534 (11%) were apprehended by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).

Additional reporting from New York.

२० जनवरी २०२५ स॑ शुरू होलऽ ट्रंप केरऽ दोसरऽ प्रशासन न॑ आप्रवासन प्रवर्तन केरऽ सख्त नीति अपनान॑ छै । अमेरिकी आप्रवासन आरू सीमा शुल्क प्रवर्तन (आईसीई) सहित संघीय एजेंसी न॑ अंतिम हटाबै के आदेश, वीजा म॑ अधिक ठहरना, आरू शरण के दावा स॑ इनकार करलऽ गेलऽ व्यक्तियऽ क॑ देश निकाला क॑ प्राथमिकता देल॑ छै ।

2026 केरऽ शुरुआती महीना म॑ चार्टर फ्लाइट प॑ भारी संख्या म॑ नेपाली क॑ देश निकाला करलऽ गेलै ।अकेले जनवरी म॑ १०१ नेपाली क॑ देश निकाला करलऽ गेलै, जेकरा म॑ ८० लोगऽ — ७९ पुरुष आरू एक महिला — शामिल छेलै जे एकल चार्टर फ्लाइट स॑ काठमांडू पहुँचलै । फरवरी म॑ भी ई प्रवृत्ति जारी रहलै, जब॑ चार्टर फ्लाइट के माध्यम स॑ ९५ नेपाली क॑ देश निकाला करलऽ गेलै, ओकरऽ बाद मार्च म॑ ४३ क॑ देश निकाला करलऽ गेलै ।

ट्रंप प्रशासन केरऽ पहलऽ १३ महीना के दौरान आईसीई न॑ अमेरिका केरऽ ३८८ नेपाली नागरिकऽ क॑ गिरफ्तार करी लेलकै, जेकरा म॑ १२४ व्यक्ति शामिल छै, जेकरा प॑ या त॑ आपराधिक आरोप के सामना करना पड़लऽ छेलै या ओकरा प॑ पूर्व आपराधिक सजा मिललऽ छेलै, ई बात क॑ डिपोर्टेशन डाटा प्रोजेक्ट द्वारा संकलित आरू संसाधित करलऽ गेलऽ आईसीई केरऽ आंकड़ऽ के अनुसार छै ।

फरवरी २०२५ सँ फरवरी २०२६ धरि आइसीई द्वारा गिरफ्तार कएल गेल नेपाली मे मात्र ३१.९% पर आपराधिक आरोप वा पूर्व सजा लंबित छल । शेष 264 लोक पर केवल आप्रवासन प्रवर्तन उल्लंघन क आरोप छल।

आंतरिक आईसीई रिकॉर्ड संकेत करैत अछि जे आपराधिक रिकॉर्ड या लंबित आरोप वाला 124 व्यक्ति मे सं 53 व्यक्ति पर पूर्व सजा आ 71 पर लंबित आरोप के सामना करय पड़ल छल.

गृह सुरक्षा विभाग (डीएचएस) न॑ कहल॑ छै कि आईसीई द्वारा देश भर म॑ गिरफ्तार करलऽ गेलऽ लगभग ७०% व्यक्ति प॑ आपराधिक आरोप या पूर्व सजा लंबित छै, लेकिन नेपाली नागरिकऽ स॑ जुड़लऽ आंकड़ा एगो उल्लेखनीय रूप स॑ अलग पैटर्न पेश करै छै: आईसीई द्वारा गिरफ्तार करलऽ गेलऽ तीन म॑ स॑ एक स॑ कम नेपाली म॑ गिरफ्तारी के समय दर्ज आपराधिक सजा या लंबित आपराधिक मामला छेलै ।

आईसीई फिलाडेल्फिया न॑ २८ जनवरी क॑ फिलाडेल्फिया केरऽ एगो कार वॉश म॑ वर्कसाइट एनफोर्समेंट ऑपरेशन करलकै, जेकरा म॑ सात अदस्तावेज रहित आप्रवासी क॑ गिरफ्तार करी लेलऽ गेलै ।

नेपाली नागरिकक मासिक गिरफ्तारी मे उतार-चढ़ाव होइत छल मुदा डीएचएस द्वारा उद्धृत ७०% आपराधिक सीमा धरि कहियो नहि पहुँचल । 2025 मे आईसीई फरवरी मे 29, मार्च मे 15, अप्रैल मे 5, मई मे 27, जून मे 27, जुलाई मे 27, अगस्त मे 35, सितम्बर मे 35, अक्टूबर मे 38, नवम्बर मे 48, आ दिसम्बर मे 42 नेपाली कें गिरफ्तार केलक अछि.

आइसीई जनवरी २०२६ मे २९ आ फरवरी २०२६ मे १९ गोटे नेपाली के गिरफ्तार केलक अछि ।

गिरफ्तार करलौ गेलौ लोगौ मँ पुरुषौ के विशाल बहुमत छेलै: ३७० पुरुष, १७ महिला, आरू एक व्यक्ति जेकरा “अज्ञात” के रूप मँ सूचीबद्ध करलौ गेलौ छेलै । गिरफ्तार भेल ३८८ नेपालीमे १७४ गोटेके अन्तिम हटाबयके आदेश छल, १९५ गोटेके अखनहु अन्तिम आदेश नहि छल, आ १९ गोटेके कानूनी दर्जा अनिर्दिष्ट छल ।

एहि ३८८ व्यक्तिमे सँ १५६ गोटेके आईसीई नेपाल निर्वासित कएने अछि । जनवरी २०२५ सँ अमेरिका सँ निर्वासित लगभग ८०० नेपाली मे ई सब शामिल अछि ।

एकटा अलग देशव्यापी ट्रैक अध्ययन म॑ पता चललै कि 11 जुलाई, 2026 तलक देश भर म॑ आईसीई हिरासत म॑ बंद 65,765 आप्रवासी म॑ स॑ 46,436 (70.65%) प॑ कोनों आपराधिक सजा नै छै । दोषी ठहराबै वाला म॑ स॑ बहुत म॑ छोटऽ-छोटऽ उल्लंघन, जेना कि यातायात के उल्लंघन शामिल छेलै ।

आईसीई केरऽ हिरासत म॑ रहलऽ सब व्यक्ति म॑ स॑ ५८,२३१ (८९%) क॑ सीधे आईसीई न॑ गिरफ्तार करी लेल॑ छेलै, जबकि ७,५३४ (११%) क॑ अमेरिकी सीमा शुल्क आरू सीमा सुरक्षा (सीबीपी) न॑ गिरफ्तार करी लेल॑ छेलै ।

न्यूयॉर्क स अतिरिक्त रिपोर्टिंग।

title: Five bodies spotted in Nepal, nine months after deadly avalanche - Yahoo
description: Five bodies spotted in Nepal, nine months after deadly avalanche  Yahoo
publisher.title: Yahoo
full_article:
Nine months after a fatal avalanche in the Himalayas, five bodies have been found.

Nepalese authorities have not ruled out the possibility that these are the bodies of five mountaineers, including a German national, who have been missing since then. However, the bodies have reportedly not yet been recovered or identified.

The accident occurred on Yalung Ri, a mountain 5,630 metres high.

Biswash Karki, head of the local council in Gaurishankar, on the border with Tibet, told dpa that he assumed the dead were the missing mountaineers.

The five missing people were part of a group of 15 mountaineers who were caught in an avalanche last November whilst attempting to climb the summit of Yalung Ri.

The bodies of two Nepalese mountain guides were recovered at the time, and eight other members of the group were rescued.

In addition to the German, two Italians and one climber each from France and Canada were also reported missing.

नेपाली अधिकारी ई संभावना स॑ इनकार नै करलकै कि ई सब एगो जर्मन नागरिक सहित पाँच पर्वतारोही के शव छै, जे तहिया स॑ लापता छै । मुदा खबरि अछि जे एखन धरि लाश बरामद नहि भ सकल अछि आ ने ओकर पहचान नहि भ सकल अछि।

दुर्घटना ५,६३० मीटर ऊँच पहाड़ यालुंग री पर भेल अछि ।

तिब्बत के सीमा पर गौरीशंकर के स्थानीय परिषद के प्रमुख विश्वास कार्की डीपीए के कहलनि जे, ओ मृतक के लापता पर्वतारोही मानैत छथि।

लापता पांच लोग 15 पर्वतारोही के एगो समूह के हिस्सा छेलै जे पिछला नवंबर म॑ यालुंग री के चोटी प॑ चढ़ै के कोशिश करतें हुअ॑ हिमस्खलन म॑ फंसलऽ छेलै ।

ओहि समय दू नेपाली पर्वत गाइड के शव बरामद भेल छल, आ समूह के आठ अन्य सदस्य के बचाओल गेल छल ।

title: ‘Discovery of Lanka’ Yatra to Link Nepal, India and Sri Lanka; Sita Utsav Planned at Ashoka Vatika - asiancommunitynews.com
description: ‘Discovery of Lanka’ Yatra to Link Nepal, India and Sri Lanka; Sita Utsav Planned at Ashoka Vatika  asiancommunitynews.com
publisher.title: asiancommunitynews.com
full_article:
New Delhi, India: An ambitious cross-border cultural initiative tracing the civilizational journey associated with Maa Sita and the Ramayana will bring Nepal, India and Sri Lanka together this December, with the 11-day “Discovery of Lanka” international yatra scheduled from December 13 to 23, 2026.

At the centre of the initiative will be Sita Utsav, a three-day cultural celebration planned from December 17 to 19 at the Seetha Amman Temple, associated with Ashoka Vatika, in Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka. Organised by the Sanatani Ganga Foundation (SGF), the initiative has been conceived as a convergence of civilizational heritage, cultural diplomacy, performing arts, youth participation, sports and spiritual tourism.

Captain Praveen Kumar, Founder of the Sanatani Ganga Foundation, said the initiative sought to transform the shared Ramayana heritage of South Asia into a contemporary platform for regional connectivity.

“The journey of Maa Sita is not confined by modern national boundaries. It connects Nepal, India and Sri Lanka through a civilizational memory that has survived for generations. Through Discovery of Lanka and Sita Utsav, we want to bring that shared heritage alive and use it to strengthen friendship and people-to-people relations across the region,” Kumar said.

The broader journey has been conceptualised around a trilateral cultural axis connecting Janakpur in Nepal, Ayodhya in India and Nuwara Eliya in Sri Lanka. SGF describes the route as part of an ancient Vedic-Buddha Corridor, highlighting the deep cultural and spiritual links among the three South Asian countries.

More than 200 delegates, including dignitaries, Union and State Ministers, cultural personalities, Bollywood representatives, Vedic scholars and university students, are expected to participate. The initiative aims to strengthen people-to-people ties, encourage regional harmony and bring heritage conservation onto a wider international platform.

Sita Utsav to become cultural heart of the journey: The principal cultural programmes will unfold in Nuwara Eliya, focusing on the qualities traditionally associated with Maa Sita—courage, dignity, compassion, devotion, resilience, patience and inner strength.

One of the flagship programmes, “Dance for Maa Sita,” will invite classical and folk dancers, choreographers, theatre practitioners, musicians, cultural institutions, university groups and emerging artists from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal and other countries connected with the Ramayana tradition.

The programme envisages Indian classical traditions including Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Odissi, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam and Manipuri, alongside Sri Lankan traditional dance and other folk and devotional forms.

Importantly, collaborative productions between Indian and Sri Lankan artists are being encouraged, turning the programme into a cultural dialogue rather than simply a series of performances.

Kumar said art could communicate civilizational connections in a way conventional conferences often could not.

“We want artists from different traditions to interpret Maa Sita in their own cultural languages. When Indian, Sri Lankan, Nepali and international artists share the same platform, the Ramayana becomes not simply a story of the past but a living dialogue among cultures,” he said.

Ramayana narrative through theatre: Another major component, Natya Rūpāntaran, will use theatre, dance-drama, music, narration, costumes and visual storytelling to recreate episodes associated with Sita and Lanka.

The presentations will focus particularly on the Sundara Kanda, Lanka Kanda and Lanka Katha, combining traditional performance techniques with contemporary stagecraft. The intention is to present the Ramayana as a living cultural tradition rather than solely as a literary or historical narrative.

‘Run for Maa Sita’ to engage youth through sport: Adding a modern dimension to the heritage initiative will be “Run for Maa Sita,” envisioned as the sporting and youth-engagement pillar of Sita Utsav.

Professional athletes, marathon runners, para-athletes, sportspersons, fitness personalities, running clubs, university teams, school students and ordinary citizens are proposed to participate.

The concept seeks to connect the spirit of the Ramayana journey with contemporary ideas of fitness, discipline, endurance and unity. Participants from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal and other countries will be encouraged to run together in a symbolic expression of friendship rather than participate solely as competitors.

“Culture cannot remain confined to auditoriums and religious spaces. Young people have to experience heritage through activities they relate to. Run for Maa Sita is about bringing together heritage, sport and youth and conveying the message that cultural bonds can transcend borders,” Kumar said.

Ramayana Trail as a tourism and heritage network: Beyond the December events, SGF plans to use the initiative to strengthen the wider Ramayana Trail as an international cultural and spiritual tourism circuit.

Cultural institutions, tourism boards, historians, heritage custodians, international tourism partners and spiritual travellers have been invited to participate. Greater global visibility for such sacred circuits, the Foundation believes, could help local economies while encouraging responsible conservation of heritage and ecological assets, including Sri Lanka’s Hakgala biosphere.

Youth participation through eco-conscious treks, academic interactions and artistic showcases will form another pillar of the programme.

For SGF, the larger objective is to build a continuing cultural network rather than organise a one-time pilgrimage.

As Kumar put it, “Discovery of Lanka is ultimately about rediscovering what already connects us. If heritage can bring communities, artists, young people, policymakers and travellers together, it can become a powerful instrument of cultural diplomacy, tourism and regional harmony.”

Through its combination of pilgrimage, performing arts, theatre, sport and heritage tourism, Discovery of Lanka and Sita Utsav 2026 are thus being positioned as an effort to transform a shared ancient narrative into a contemporary bridge linking Nepal, India and Sri Lanka.

नई दिल्ली, भारत : माँ सीता आरू रामायण स॑ जुड़लऽ सभ्यता यात्रा के पता लगाबै वाला एगो महत्वाकांक्षी सीमा पार सांस्कृतिक पहल ई दिसंबर म॑ नेपाल, भारत आरू श्रीलंका क॑ एक साथ लान॑ छै, जेकरा म॑ १३ दिन स॑ २३ दिसंबर २०२६ तलक ११ दिन के “लंका के खोज” अंतर्राष्ट्रीय यात्रा के कार्यक्रम छै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, हम चाहैत छी जे अलग-अलग परंपरा के कलाकार माँ सीता के अपन सांस्कृतिक भाषा मे व्याख्या करथि, जखन भारतीय, श्रीलंका, नेपाली आ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कलाकार एक मंच साझा करैत छथि त रामायण मात्र अतीत के कहानी नहि बल्कि संस्कृति के बीच जीवंत संवाद बनि जाइत अछि।

रंगमंच के माध्यम स रामायण कथ्य : एकटा आओर प्रमुख घटक नाट्य रूपांतरण में सीता आ लंका स जुड़ल प्रकरण के पुनर्निर्माण के लेल रंगमंच, नृत्य-नाटक, संगीत, कथ्य, वेशभूषा आ दृश्य कथाक उपयोग होयत।

प्रस्तुति म॑ विशेष रूप स॑ सुंदर कांडा, लंका कांडा आरू लंका कथा प॑ ध्यान देलऽ जैतै, जेकरा म॑ पारंपरिक प्रदर्शन तकनीक के साथ समकालीन मंचशिल्प के संयोजन करलऽ जैतै । रामायण के मात्र साहित्यिक या ऐतिहासिक कथ्य के रूप में नै बल्कि एकटा जीवित सांस्कृतिक परंपरा के रूप में प्रस्तुत करबाक उद्देश्य अछि |

खेल के माध्यम स॑ युवा सिनी क॑ संलग्न करै लेली ‘रन फॉर माँ सीता’ : धरोहर पहल म॑ आधुनिक आयाम जोड़ना “रन फॉर माँ सीता” होतै, जेकरा सीता उत्सव केरऽ खेल आरू युवा-संलग्नता के स्तंभ के रूप म॑ परिकल्पित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

पेशेवर एथलीट, मैराथन धावक, पैरा एथलीट, खेलाड़ी, फिटनेस व्यक्तित्व, रनिंग क्लब, विश्वविद्यालय टीम, स्कूली छात्र आ आम नागरिक कें भाग लेवा कें प्रस्ताव छै.

ई अवधारणा रामायण यात्रा के भावना क॑ फिटनेस, अनुशासन, सहनशक्ति आरू एकता के समकालीन विचारऽ स॑ जोड़ै के कोशिश करै छै । भारत, श्रीलंका, नेपाल आरू अन्य देशऽ के प्रतिभागी क॑ केवल प्रतियोगी के रूप म॑ भाग लेबै के बजाय दोस्ती के प्रतीकात्मक अभिव्यक्ति म॑ एक साथ दौड़ै लेली प्रोत्साहित करलऽ जैतै ।

कुमार कहलनि जे, संस्कृति सभागार आ धार्मिक स्थान तक सीमित नहि रहि सकैत अछि, युवा के अपन संबंधी गतिविधि के माध्यम सं धरोहर के अनुभव करय पड़ैत अछि, माँ सीता के लेल दौड़ धरोहर, खेल आ युवा के एक ठाम लाबय के अछि आ ई संदेश देबय के अछि जे सांस्कृतिक बंधन सीमा के पार क सकैत अछि।

पर्यटन आरू धरोहर नेटवर्क के रूप म॑ रामायण ट्रेल : दिसंबर केरऽ आयोजनऽ स॑ परे एसजीएफ न॑ व्यापक रामायण ट्रेल क॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय सांस्कृतिक आरू आध्यात्मिक पर्यटन सर्किट के रूप म॑ मजबूत करै लेली पहल के इस्तेमाल करै के योजना बनयने छै ।

सांस्कृतिक संस्थान, पर्यटन बोर्ड, इतिहासकार, धरोहर संरक्षक, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय पर्यटन भागीदार आ आध्यात्मिक यात्री कए एहि मे भाग लेबा लेल आमंत्रित कैल गेल अछि। फाउंडेशन केरऽ मानना ​​छै कि ऐसनऽ पवित्र सर्किट लेली अधिक वैश्विक दृश्यता स्थानीय अर्थव्यवस्था क॑ मदद करी सकै छै आरू साथ ही साथ श्रीलंका केरऽ हक्काला जैवमंडल सहित धरोहर आरू पारिस्थितिकी संपत्ति केरऽ जिम्मेदार संरक्षण क॑ प्रोत्साहित करी सकै छै ।

इको-कॉन्शियस ट्रेक, शैक्षणिक बातचीत आ कलात्मक शोकेस के माध्यम सं युवा के भागीदारी कार्यक्रम के एकटा आओर स्तंभ बनत.

एसजीएफ के लेलऽ बड़ऽ उद्देश्य एक बार के तीर्थयात्रा के आयोजन के बजाय निरंतर सांस्कृतिक नेटवर्क के निर्माण करना छै ।

जेना कि कुमार कहलनि जे, “लंका के खोज अंततः ओहि चीज के फेर सं खोजब अछि जे पहिने सं हमरा सब के जोड़ैत अछि. जौं धरोहर समुदाय, कलाकार, युवा, नीति निर्माता आ यात्री के एक संग आनि सकैत अछि त ई सांस्कृतिक कूटनीति, पर्यटन आ क्षेत्रीय सौहार्द के एकटा सशक्त साधन बनि सकैत अछि।”

तीर्थयात्रा, प्रदर्शन कला, रंगमंच, खेल आरू धरोहर पर्यटन के संयोजन के माध्यम स॑ डिस्कवरी ऑफ लंका आरू सीता उत्सव २०२६ क॑ ई तरह स॑ साझा प्राचीन कथ्य क॑ नेपाल, भारत आरू श्रीलंका क॑ जोड़ै वाला समकालीन सेतु म॑ बदलै के प्रयास के रूप म॑ स्थापित करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।
