आइ राति मौसम मोटा-मोटी समान रहबाक संभावना अछि, हिमालय आ पहाड़ी क्षेत्र मे बादल छाएत आ तराई मे आंशिक रूप सँ बादल छाएत। हिमालय आ पहाड़ी क्षेत्र मे किछु ठाम मध्यम वर्षा या बर्फबारी संभव अछि, जखन कि तराई मे एक या दू ठाम मध्यम वर्षा भ सकैत अछि ।

पोखरा, काठमांडू आर्द्र शहर के बीच

पोखरा म॑ आय गरज के साथ मध्यम बारिश के अनुमान छै, जेकरा म॑ बारिश के ६० प्रतिशत संभावना आरू अधिकतम तापमान २९-३१ डिग्री सेल्सियस के अनुमान छै । आइ राति बरखा के संभावना 70 प्रतिशत भ गेल अछि, जखन कि तापमान 21-23 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक गिरय के उम्मीद अछि.

काठमांडू में दिन में गरज के साथ हल्का बारिश के संभावना छै, जेकरा में बारिश के 40 प्रतिशत संभावना आरू अधिकतम तापमान 29–31 डिग्री सेल्सियस के संभावना छै । राजधानी मे राति मे गरज के संग मध्यम बरखा भ सकैत अछि, जेकर संभावना 60 प्रतिशत तक बढ़ि सकैत अछि।

ओखलढुंगा, धनकुटा, जिरी आ ताप्लेजुङ मे सेहो दिन मे ठनका के संग मध्यम वर्षा के संभावना अछि ।

एम्हर दक्षिणी मैदानक किछु भाग अपेक्षाकृत शुष्क रहबाक संभावना अछि । नेपालगंज, भैरहवा, सिमरा आ जनकपुरमे दिनमे आंशिक रूपसँ बादल छाएत रहबाक अनुमान अछि, अखन ओहि शहरमे वर्षा नै हेबाक अनुमान अछि ।

सूचीबद्ध शहर सब मे दिनक सबसँ बेसी तापमान भैरहवा, सिमरा, विराटनगर आ जनकपुर मे ३४–३६ डिग्री सेल्सियस तक पहुँचबाक अनुमान अछि ।

title: LPG Gas Supply Disruption in Nepal Due to Hoarding Despite Increased Imports - Ratopati
description: LPG Gas Supply Disruption in Nepal Due to Hoarding Despite Increased Imports  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The import and supply of cooking gas (LPG) in Nepal are exceeding normal levels. However, an artificial shortage is being observed in the market.

According to Nepal Oil Corporation and gas industrialists, the supply system is facing problems due to consumers unnecessarily hoarding cylinders, even though imports are higher than the daily demand.

According to Gokul Bhandari, Managing Director of Nepal Gas Industries Pvt. Ltd., Nepal's normal monthly consumption is around 3.5 million cylinders. Based on this, the daily demand is about 110,000 cylinders.

However, current data shows that Nepal Oil Corporation is importing gas equivalent to 130,000 cylinders daily. Despite sending 20,000 more cylinders than regular consumption to the market, the market has not stabilized due to psychological fear among consumers and hoarding tendencies.

“Although a decision was made earlier to go with half cylinders of 7 kg, its implementation was delayed by four months due to various reasons,” said Managing Director Bhandari. “During this period, about 30,000 metric tons, equivalent to 2.1 million cylinders, of gas were imported less.

However, with consumption remaining the same, the cylinders in consumers' homes started depleting.” He analyzes that the current demand has increased unusually because refilling 14.2 kg cylinders became necessary after returning to the previous system.

Currently, there are 17.5 million cylinders in the market. This number is sufficient to meet Nepal's total consumption for five months. However, not all these cylinders are with the industries; they are in consumers' homes, either empty or half-filled. Only 40 percent of the total population uses gas. But due to hoarding tendencies, students and low-income groups are suffering the most.

Some consumers and retailers are unnecessarily hoarding gas. In the lines formed in areas like Balaju in Kathmandu, many people wanting to keep unnecessary stock were seen, more than consumers who were genuinely in trouble. It was also found that the same person was queuing up multiple times.

To streamline the supply system, industrialists have started daily reporting. Details of how much each industry imported and to which dealer how much gas was sent are being provided to Nepal Oil Corporation.

The government has now directed to keep records of which retailer sold gas to which customer. Businessmen have stated that the implementation process for this has begun. This is expected to ensure equitable distribution of gas and prevent black marketing.

Industrialists state that the current problem is not due to a decrease in gas imports but because consumers are trying to stock up. “In a place where 110,000 cylinders are consumed daily, 130,000 are arriving,” Bhandari said. “Therefore, if those who have 15 days to one month's gas stock at home do not take additional gas immediately, consumers who genuinely need it will be able to get gas easily.”

He clarified that the current situation is not like the time of the blockade or COVID-19 and urged not to hoard unnecessarily.

Meanwhile, due to the lack of concrete laws related to petroleum and explosives in Nepal, gas industries are compelled to operate based on foreign standards. So far, Nepal has not enacted its own Explosives Act or Petroleum Act. Domestic gas industries are established and operated based on the certification of Indian bodies and Indian laws.

Bhandari, who is also the Vice President of the Confederation of Nepalese Industries, said, “The legal and policy structure to regulate the LPG industry in Nepal is still weak. Industries are operating after being certified by Indian standards.”

He pointed out the need for clear laws and an effective state mechanism for the industry's safety, monitoring, and regulation.

There also appears to be a need to review the subsidy provided on gas. Currently, the state is incurring a loss of approximately 900 rupees per cylinder of gas. However, there has been no clear classification on which group should receive the concession. Currently, the same price is set for both commercial and domestic purposes.

“Currently, even the commercial sector is getting relatively cheaper gas and taking advantage of VAT refunds,” Bhandari said. “A policy of providing subsidies only to the targeted group, rather than to everyone equally, seems necessary. The system needs to be improved so that subsidies reach the actual targeted consumers.”

For a long-term solution, industrialists say that the state and private sectors need to collaborate on storage infrastructure, improvement of the distribution system, and pipeline construction. Since gas is an essential commodity and the private sector has 100 percent investment in it, the state's role is crucial in managing it. Bhandari stated that to increase gas storage capacity, similar to petroleum products, a public-private partnership (PPP) model should be adopted.

Nepal Oil Corporation is moving forward with discussions with Indian Oil Corporation regarding pipeline expansion. Businessmen believe that with such infrastructure development, many of the problems related to LPG supply and distribution can be resolved. They said that by maintaining sufficient stock during times of easy supply, future shortages can be avoided.

मुदा वर्तमान आंकड़ा बता रहल अछि जे नेपाल तेल निगम प्रतिदिन एक लाख तीस हजार सिलेंडर के बराबर गैस आयात क रहल अछि। नियमित खपत स 20 हजार बेसी सिलेंडर बाजार मे भेजला क बावजूद उपभोक्ता मे मनोवैज्ञानिक डर आ जमाखोरी क प्रवृत्ति क कारण बाजार स्थिर नहि भ सकल अछि।

प्रबंध निदेशक भंडारी कहलनि जे, हालांकि पहिने 7 किलो के हाफ सिलेंडर के संग जेबाक निर्णय लेल गेल छल, मुदा विभिन्न कारण सं एकर क्रियान्वयन मे चारि मासक देरी भेल। ओ कहला जे एहि दौरान करीब 30 हजार मीट्रिक टन गैस क आयात कम भेल, जे 21 लाख सिलेंडर क बराबर अछि।

मुदा, खपत ओहिना रहला स उपभोक्ता घर मे सिलेंडर खतम होबय लागल।” हुनकऽ विश्लेषण छै कि वर्तमान मांग असामान्य रूप स॑ बढ़ी गेलऽ छै, कैन्हेंकि पिछला सिस्टम म॑ वापसी के बाद १४.२ किलो के सिलेंडर क॑ रिफिल करना जरूरी होय गेलऽ छेलै ।

फिलहाल बाजार मे 1.75 करोड़ सिलेंडर अछि। ई संख्या पाँच मासक लेल नेपालक कुल खपत पूरा करबाक लेल पर्याप्त अछि । मुदा, ई सब सिलेंडर उद्योग सबहक संग नहिं छैक; उपभोक्ता कें घर मे छै, या त खाली या आधा भरल. कुल आबादी मे मात्र 40 प्रतिशत गैस क उपयोग करैत अछि। मुदा जमाखोरी के प्रवृत्ति के कारण सबस बेसी नुकसान छात्र आ कम आय वाला समूह के भ रहल अछि.

किछु उपभोक्ता आ खुदरा विक्रेता अनावश्यक रूप स गैस जमा क रहल छथि। काठमांडू के बालाजू सन इलाका मे बनल लाइन मे अनावश्यक स्टॉक राखय चाहय वाला बहुत लोक देखल गेल, ओहि उपभोक्ता सं बेसि जे सही मायने मे परेशानी मे पड़ल छल. इहो पता चलल जे एकहि व्यक्ति कई बेर कतार मे ठाढ़ छल।

आपूर्ति प्रणाली कए सुव्यवस्थित करबा लेल उद्योगपति रोज रिपोर्टिंग शुरू करि देलथि अछि। प्रत्येक उद्योग कतेक आयात केलक आ कोन डीलर के कतेक गैस पठाओल गेल तकर विवरण नेपाल तेल निगम के उपलब्ध कराओल जा रहल अछि ।

सरकार आब निर्देश देलक अछि जे कोन खुदरा विक्रेता कोन ग्राहक कए गैस बेचलक। व्यवसायी सब के कहनाय छनि जे एकरा लागू करय के प्रक्रिया शुरू भ गेल अछि. एहि स गैस क समान वितरण सुनिश्चित करबाक आ ब्लैक मार्केटिंग कए रोकबाक उम्मीद अछि।

उद्योगपति सब के कहनाय छनि जे वर्तमान समस्या गैस के आयात में कमी के कारण नहिं बल्कि उपभोक्ता के स्टॉक करय के कोशिश के कारण अछि. भंडारी कहला जे जाहि ठाम रोज एक लाख 10 हजार सिलेंडर क खपत भ रहल अछि, ओहि ठाम एक लाख 30 हजार सिलेंडर आबि रहल अछि। “अतः जिनका घर मे 15 दिन स एक महीना क गैस स्टॉक अछि ओ अगर तुरंत अतिरिक्त गैस नहि लेत त जे उपभोक्ता कए एकर सही मायने मे जरूरत अछि, ओकरा गैस आसानी स भेट सकैत अछि।”

ओ स्पष्ट केलनि जे वर्तमान स्थिति नाकाबंदी या कोविड-19 के समय जेकाँ नहि अछि आ अनावश्यक जमाखोरी नहि करबाक आग्रह केलनि।

एम्हर नेपाल मे पेट्रोलियम आ विस्फोटक स संबंधित ठोस कानून नहि रहला स गैस उद्योग विदेशी मानक क आधार पर संचालित करबा लेल बाध्य अछि। एखन धरि नेपाल अपन विस्फोटक अधिनियम वा पेट्रोलियम कानून नहि बनौलक अछि । घरेलू गैस उद्योगक कें स्थापना आ संचालन भारतीय निकाय आ भारतीय कानून कें प्रमाणीकरण कें आधार पर कैल जायत छै.

नेपाली उद्योग महासंघक उपाध्यक्ष सेहो रहल भंडारी कहलनि जे, “नेपाल मे एलपीजी उद्योग केँ नियमन करबाक लेल कानूनी आ नीतिगत संरचना एखनो कमजोर अछि।उद्योग भारतीय मानक सँ प्रमाणित भेलाक बाद संचालित भ’ रहल अछि।”

हुनी उद्योग के सुरक्षा, निगरानी, ​​आरू नियमन लेली स्पष्ट कानून आरू प्रभावी राज्य तंत्र के जरूरत के ओर इशारा करलकै ।

गैस पर देल गेल सब्सिडी क समीक्षा करबाक सेहो जरूरत देखा रहल अछि। फिलहाल राज्य कए गैस क प्रति सिलेंडर लगभग 900 टका क नुकसान भ रहल अछि। मुदा एहि पर कोनो स्पष्ट वर्गीकरण नहि भेल अछि जे कोन समूह कए इ रियायत भेटबाक चाही। फिलहाल व्यावसायिक आ घरेलू दुनू काज लेल एकहि दाम तय कैल गेल अछि।

भण्डारी कहला जे फिलहाल वाणिज्यिक क्षेत्र मे सेहो गैस अपेक्षाकृत सस्ता भ रहल अछि आ वैट वापसी क फायदा उठा रहल अछि। “सब्सिडी सब्सिडी देबय के नीति सब के समान रूप स नै बल्कि केवल लक्षित समूह के देबय के नीति जरूरी बुझाइत अछि।सिस्टम में सुधार के जरूरत अछि ताकि सब्सिडी वास्तविक लक्षित उपभोक्ता तक पहुंचय।”

दीर्घकालिक समाधान कें लेल उद्योगपतिक कें कहनाय छै कि राज्य आ निजी क्षेत्रक कें भंडारण बुनियादी ढाँचा, वितरण प्रणाली मे सुधार, आ पाइपलाइन निर्माण पर सहयोग करय कें जरूरत छै. चूँकि गैस एकटा आवश्यक वस्तु अछि आ निजी क्षेत्र कए एहि मे शत-प्रतिशत निवेश अछि, एहि लेल एकर प्रबंधन मे राज्य क भूमिका बहुत महत्वपूर्ण अछि। भंडारी नँ कहलकै कि पेट्रोलियम उत्पाद के समान गैस भंडारण क्षमता बढ़ाबै लेली सार्वजनिक-निजी साझेदारी (पीपीपी) मॉडल अपनाबै के चाही ।

नेपाल तेल निगम पाइपलाइन विस्तार के संबंध मे भारतीय तेल निगम के संग चर्चा के संग आगू बढ़ि रहल अछि। व्यवसायी के मानब छै कि एहि तरहक बुनियादी ढांचा के विकास सं एलपीजी के आपूर्ति आ वितरण सं जुड़ल बहुत रास समस्या के समाधान भ सकैत अछि. ओ सब कहला जे आसान आपूर्ति क समय मे पर्याप्त स्टॉक रखला स भविष्य मे कमी स बचल जा सकैत अछि।

KATHMANDU, AUGUST 11

Cimex Inc, the authorised distributor and service provider of BYD vehicles in Nepal, has launched a nationwide customer care campaign aimed at enhancing after-sales services, vehicle connectivity and ownership protection for existing customers.

The "BYD Update to Care+" campaign was inaugurated at Cimex Care, the BYD service centre in Guheshwori, and is now available across the company's 13 service centres nationwide.

Under the campaign, eligible BYD vehicles delivered before September 2024 that did not previously have connected-car features will receive complimentary BYD App connectivity and infotainment activation.

title: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal After Medical Treatment - Ratopati
description: Sher Bahadur Deuba Returns to Nepal After Medical Treatment  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Top leaders of the Nepali Congress will arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport to welcome former party president Sher Bahadur Deuba, who is scheduled to return to the country on Thursday after medical treatment.

Leader Min Bishwakarma informed that top leaders will go to the airport to welcome Deuba under the leadership of Dr. Shashank Koirala, coordinator of the National Gathering Preparation Committee, which the Nepali Congress's establishment- इतर (former president Deuba and Dr. Shekhar Koirala) group is organizing in Kathmandu from Shrawan 29.

'Top leaders will go to the airport under the leadership of Dr. Shashank Koirala, coordinator of the National Gathering Organizing Committee, to welcome him (Deuba),' Bishwakarma told Ratopati. 'A large group including former acting president Purna Bahadur Khadka, leader Dr. Shekhar Koirala, former office bearers, and central members will go to the airport to welcome him.'

According to Bishwakarma, Deuba is scheduled to land at Tribhuvan International Airport at 12 PM on Thursday via Thai Air from Thailand. The इतर group of Congress has made preparations to give a grand welcome to leader Deuba, who is returning to the country after a long period of treatment.

Deuba, who left Nepal for medical treatment in Singapore on February 13, reached Hong Kong on March 7 for further treatment after completing his treatment there. Bishwakarma informed that Deuba's program was to go to Thailand from Hong Kong and return to Nepal from Thailand.

On August 24, during the 'Gen Z' movement, protestors severely beat Deuba couple at their residence in Budhanilkantha, leaving them near death. After a long treatment at the Military Hospital in Chhauni, Deuba couple went to Singapore for further treatment.

His family sources have been stating that Deuba has been undergoing treatment abroad for a long time due to health complications arising from the same incident.

Leaders have said that Deuba will be active in the party's internal activities immediately after returning to the country. Bishwakarma, coordinator of the publicity committee, confirmed that former Prime Minister Deuba is scheduled to address the national gathering organized by the इतर group in Kathmandu from Shrawan 29 to 31.

The dispute that emerged after the special general convention in the last week of Poush within Congress has reached its peak. Leaders are publicizing that Deuba will address the national gathering organized by the इतर group amidst that dispute.

full_article:
Another FIFA World Cup came to a close, demonstrating the absolute pinnacle of international football. Despite the global spectacle, fans of nations that missed qualification felt a common void. Nepal was no exception. The current administrative negligence of Nepali sports only makes the dream seem more distant.

ANFA's governance issues-mismanagement, the absence of dedicated leaders, and political infighting-take a direct toll on national players' ability to perform at their full potential. Almost 60 days have passed since FIFA imposed a ban on ANFA on account of its failure to fulfill eligibility criteria. Yet, no informed actions or strategic decisions have been taken to mitigate the consequences. Consequently, the future of Nepali sports and athletes remains in limbo.

Related Articles FIFA suspends ANFA with immediate effect, bars Nepal from international football The Wildest FIFA World Cup Debate Begins ft. Niti Shah & Rabin Shrestha | Xtreme Football Circus

An athlete's prime career span is roughly eight to ten years. A two-year ban and stalled leagues consume a significant portion of their active careers, effectively stifling their progress. Echoing the reality of leaders on the pitch, Nepali national team central midfielder Sumit Shrestha noted, "As players, our primary focus is always on football. We hope the situation is resolved soon so that we can concentrate on the game and our future." Zero scouting and narrow possibilities of international exposure have led to dire consequences. This has significantly exacerbated the number of players leaving the country seeking better opportunities abroad. There has been a drastic surge in potential athletes opting for non-sporting jobs for financial security and long-term stability over uncertain domestic futures.

This institutional failure has a ripple effect on every entity within the ecosystem: local clubs, academies, and grassroots youth programs all face a steep decline in their overall growth and functioning. The places where young talents are recognized and fostered now lack direction, like a ship with nowhere to land. The absence of local heroes to look up to disrupts the chain of inspiration for current and future generations-a lack of trailblazers and inspiring stories takes a heavy toll on budding athletes. Additionally, the psychological strain that players endure-having spent their entire youth training for a career that administrative politics froze overnight-cannot be overlooked. Giving a lifetime to a dream, having everything it takes to bring it to life, only to be obstructed by circumstances beyond their control feels like a profound act of injustice.

एनएफए केरऽ शासन संबंधी मुद्दा-कुप्रबंधन, समर्पित नेता केरऽ अनुपस्थिति, आरू राजनीतिक अंदरूनी लड़ाई-राष्ट्रीय खिलाड़ी केरऽ पूरा क्षमता स॑ प्रदर्शन करै के क्षमता प॑ सीधा असर डालै छै । पात्रता के मानदंड पूरा नै करला के कारण फीफा न॑ एनएफए प॑ प्रतिबंध लगैला के लगभग ६० दिन बीती गेलऽ छै । तइयो एकरऽ परिणाम क॑ कम करै लेली कोय सूचित कार्रवाई या रणनीतिक निर्णय नै लेलऽ गेलऽ छै । फलस्वरूप नेपाली खेलकूद आ एथलीटके भविष्य अनिश्चिततामे बनल अछि ।

description: Nepal’s para swimmers chase Asian Games glory despite lack of facilities  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Swimming requires water, but for para swimmers, getting into the pool is only the beginning.

Regular training, accessible infrastructure, qualified coaches, physiotherapy, recovery facilities, nutrition, transportation and financial support are equally important.

Nepal’s para swimmers, however, are preparing for international competition amid a shortage of many of these basic facilities. Despite limited resources and difficult circumstances, they are training with the dream of flying Nepal’s flag high at the upcoming Para Asian Games.

Nepal has been participating in the Para Asian Games since 2010. However, its achievement at the continental event remains limited.

So far, Nepal has won only one medal at the Para Asian Games — a bronze secured by taekwondo athlete Palesha Goverdhan in the under-56 kg category at the 19th Asian Para Games in 2023.

Nepal’s para swimming team now hopes to add a new chapter to that history.

Training continues despite challenges

Under the Nepal Para Swimming Association, head coach Subas Shrestha has been providing regular training to four athletes — Srijana Sarki, Jenisha Kathayat, Harkaman Gharti and Member Singi Syangbo.

The athletes have been training regularly for the past five to six months.

According to coach Shrestha, the athletes have shown good commitment during training. However, a shortage of resources and facilities has made it difficult to take their preparations to the desired level.

Access to a swimming pool itself had been a major challenge. Training has become somewhat easier after Refresh Recreation Centre made its swimming pool and lanes available at a concessional rate.

But the challenges extend beyond the pool.

Physiotherapy, recovery facilities, jacuzzi services, nutrition, transportation and specialised sporting equipment remain difficult to arrange for the athletes.

For Shrestha, the biggest challenge is preparing the athletes for international-level competition with limited resources.

The athletes have talent and determination, he says, but inadequate facilities make it difficult for them to prepare according to their full potential.

Yet, their confidence and commitment continue to drive the team forward.

Srijana’s first international dream

For 19-year-old Srijana Sarki, swimming is more than a sport. It is also a way of proving herself.

Sarki, originally from Jumla in Karnali Province, saw her life change three years ago after she was buried in a landslide while digging soil. The accident left her living with a disability and brought a series of challenges.

But she refused to give up on her dreams.

Currently preparing for undergraduate studies while living in Gokarneshwor, Sarki regularly travels to her training venue. Sometimes she takes a taxi and sometimes a tempo to reach practice.

She has been putting particular focus on swimming for the past three months.

The upcoming competition will be her first international event.

She is excited about getting the opportunity to represent Nepal for the first time and is determined to perform to the best of her ability and compete for a medal.

For Sarki, simply reaching an international competition is already a major achievement.

But she does not want to limit herself to participation.

When she enters the water, she wants her ability — rather than the pain of her past — to define her.

Harkaman: From losing both hands to finding identity in swimming

The story of 21-year-old Harkaman Gharti of Baglung is also one of extraordinary resilience.

Eleven years ago, electricity was connected to his village for the first time. During the process, Gharti suffered an electric shock after touching a main insulator.

The accident resulted in the loss of both his hands.

But the physical loss did not diminish his determination to compete in sport.

Gharti has been active in domestic sports for the past six years and now hopes to prove his ability at the international level through swimming.

A year ago, he obtained an international athlete licence in Japan.

However, he continues to face a shortage of essential recovery facilities, including jacuzzi services and physiotherapy.

Because of these limitations, Gharti says he cannot guarantee a medal at the upcoming competition.

His ambitions, however, extend beyond a single medal.

He wants to accumulate the necessary experience and qualification standards to compete at future Olympic and World Championship events.

For Gharti, swimming is not simply about competition. It has become a way to introduce himself to the world on his own terms.

Jenisha gets another chance

For Jenisha Kathayat from Sudurpaschim Province, swimming is not a new journey.

She has been involved in the sport for nine years.

While studying in Grade 10, she lost a leg. Yet she did not give up swimming. Instead, she turned the challenge into motivation and made the sport part of her identity.

Kathayat has already represented Nepal at the 19th Asian Games in China.

She could not deliver the performance she had hoped for at the event, but the experience did not weaken her confidence.

Instead, it strengthened her determination to return better prepared.

While continuing her higher education, Kathayat has also maintained her focus on training.

This time, she wants to turn her previous international experience into an improved performance.

Her target is clear — a medal.

Member Singi: From an accident to the swimming lane

Among the four athletes, Member Singi Syangbo’s journey from a road accident to the swimming pool is equally remarkable.

At the age of 17, Syangbo was involved in a road accident near the Rasuwagadhi border with China.

He had been working as a helper on a Nepali container truck and had travelled to China while learning to drive and gaining experience.

While waiting for his turn at the border, another vehicle suddenly struck him.

The accident resulted in the loss of one of his legs.

Life was not easy after the accident.

While arranging for a prosthetic leg, however, Syangbo came into contact with swimming.

He had never planned to become a swimmer.

After getting an opportunity, he entered the pool with little more than the thought of giving it a try.

Gradually, swimming became an important part of his life.

Now 26, Syangbo trains every day. He has been undergoing regular training for around two months and says his preparations are progressing well.

Swimming is no longer simply a way to spend time.

His ambitions changed after he began competing.

“Bringing home a medal” is now his clear objective.

Syangbo believes Nepal has a good chance of winning a medal in para swimming this time and continues to train with that goal.

Although the relevant organisations have provided some assistance with training and daily expenses, he says not all the facilities required for high-level preparation are available.

His confidence, however, remains strong.

Four athletes, one goal

Srijana is preparing for her first international competition.

Jenisha wants to improve on her previous international performance.

Harkaman has his sights set on the qualification pathway for future Olympics and World Championships.

Member Singi wants to win a medal at his first major international opportunity.

Their stories are different.

One was left with a disability after a landslide. Another lost both hands in an electrical accident. Another lost a leg during adolescence. The fourth lost a leg in a road accident.

But they share one thing — an unwavering determination to compete.

Their biggest challenge remains the shortage of facilities.

There is limited funding, inadequate accessible sports infrastructure and insufficient access to physiotherapy, recovery facilities, equipment and nutrition.

Even reaching the training venue can require a personal struggle.

Yet, once they enter the pool, those difficulties are temporarily pushed aside.

In the swimming lane, they focus on their abilities rather than their physical conditions. Every stroke is an attempt to improve their time, and every training session brings them closer to their dream of performing on the international stage.

A coach’s challenge

For head coach Subas Shrestha, the four athletes are not merely competitors. They are athletes with significant potential.

Their determination and work ethic are strong, but competing internationally requires regular and scientific training.

That requires time, equipment, facilities and financial resources.

Preparing athletes with limited resources remains a major challenge for Shrestha, but their potential continues to motivate him.

His approach is to focus on the athletes’ abilities rather than their limitations, making the best possible use of available resources to improve their technique, timing and performance.

However, if Nepal wants to target international medals, he believes their preparation needs to become more systematic and long-term.

Dreams in the water

Nepal’s para-sports sector still has a long way to go.

A single medal cannot transform the sporting landscape. Sustained investment, infrastructure, training and long-term support for athletes are necessary.

For now, four athletes are searching for their future in the swimming pool.

Srijana wants to prove herself on her first international journey.

Harkaman wants to take his sporting career towards the Olympics and World Championships.

Jenisha hopes to turn her previous international experience into a stronger performance.

And Member Singi wants to transform the pain of losing a leg into the joy of winning a medal.

What they need most is an opportunity.

They have the ability to work hard. They have dreams. And they have the determination to represent Nepal.

The question now is not only how hard these four athletes are willing to work, but also how much support the state and sporting authorities are willing to provide.

Their story carries a simple message: physical limitations do not have to limit dreams. But turning those dreams into international medals requires opportunity, investment and support.

काठमांडू : हेलबा लेल पानि चाही, मुदा पैरा तैराक लेल पूल मे घुसब त शुरुआत मात्र अछि।

नियमित प्रशिक्षण, सुलभ बुनियादी ढाँचा, योग्य कोच, फिजियोथेरेपी, रिकवरी सुविधा, पोषण, परिवहन आ आर्थिक सहायता ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण छै.

नेपाल केरऽ पैरा तैराक, हालांकि, ऐन्हऽ बहुत सारा बुनियादी सुविधा के कमी के बीच अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता के तैयारी करी रहलऽ छै । सीमित संसाधन आ कठिन परिस्थिति के बावजूद आगामी पैरा एशियाई खेल मे नेपाल के झंडा ऊँच फहराबय के सपना ल क प्रशिक्षण ल रहल छथिन्ह.

नेपाल २०१० सँ पारा एशियन खेलमे भाग लैत आबि रहल अछि ।मुदा महाद्वीपीय आयोजनमे ओकर उपलब्धि सीमित अछि ।

अब तलक नेपाल न॑ पैरा एशियाई खेलऽ म॑ खाली एगो पदक जीती चुकलऽ छै — जेकरा २०२३ म॑ १९वां एशियाई पैरा गेम्स म॑ ५६ किलोग्राम स॑ कम उम्र के वर्ग म॑ ताइक्वांडो एथलीट पलेशा गोवर्धन न॑ कांस्य पदक जीतल॑ छेलै ।

नेपाल के पैरा तैराकी टीम के आब उम्मीद अछि जे ओहि इतिहास मे एकटा नव अध्याय जोड़ल जाएत.

चुनौती के बावजूद प्रशिक्षण जारी अछि

नेपाल पारा तैराकी संघ के अन्तर्गत मुख्य प्रशिक्षक सुबास श्रेष्ठ चारिटा एथलीट — सृजना सरकी, जेनिशा कथायत, हरकमन घरती आ सदस्य सिंगबो के नियमित प्रशिक्षण दैत आबि रहल अछि ।

पिछला पांच स छह मास स एथलीट नियमित रूप स प्रशिक्षण ल रहल छथि।

कोच श्रेष्ठ के अनुसार प्रशिक्षण के दौरान एथलीट सब नीक प्रतिबद्धता देखौलक अछि। मुदा संसाधन आ सुविधा के कमी के कारण हुनकर तैयारी के वांछित स्तर पर पहुंचाबय मे दिक्कत भ गेल अछि.

स्विमिंग पूल तक पहुंच स्वयं एकटा पैघ चुनौती रहल छल। रिफ्रेश रिक्रिएशन सेंटर न॑ अपनऽ स्विमिंग पूल आरू लेन क॑ रियायती दर प॑ उपलब्ध कराय देला के बाद प्रशिक्षण कुछ आसान होय ​​गेलऽ छै ।

मुदा चुनौती पूल स आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि।

एथलीटऽ लेली फिजियोथेरेपी, रिकवरी सुविधा, जकूजी सेवा, पोषण, परिवहन आरू विशेष खेल उपकरण के व्यवस्था करना मुश्किल बनलऽ छै ।

श्रेष्ठ के लेलऽ सबसें बड़ऽ चुनौती सीमित संसाधन के साथ अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर के प्रतियोगिता लेली एथलीटऽ क॑ तैयार करना छै ।

हुनकऽ कहना छै कि एथलीटऽ म॑ प्रतिभा आरू दृढ़ संकल्प छै, लेकिन अपर्याप्त सुविधा के वजह स॑ हुनका अपनऽ पूरा क्षमता के अनुसार तैयारी करना मुश्किल होय जाय छै ।

तइयो हुनकऽ आत्मविश्वास आरू प्रतिबद्धता टीम क॑ आगू बढ़ाबै के काम जारी छै ।

सृजन के पहिल अंतरराष्ट्रीय सपना

19 वर्षीय सृजना सरकी लेल तैराकी खेल स बेसी अछि। ई अपना के साबित करय के तरीका सेहो अछि.

मूल रूप स कर्णाली प्रांत क जुमला क रहनिहार सरकी तीन साल पहिने माटि खोदैत काल भूस्खलन मे दफन भ गेलाक बाद अपन जीवन बदलि गेल छलीह। दुर्घटना के कारण हुनका विकलांगता के साथ रहय पड़लनि आ चुनौती के सिलसिला सेहो आबि गेलनि।

मुदा ओ अपन सपना सँ हार मानय सँ मना क देलनि।

वर्तमान में गोकर्णेश्वर में रहैत स्नातक के तैयारी में लागल सरकी नियमित रूप स अपन प्रशिक्षण स्थल पर जाइत छथि । कखनो टैक्सी त कखनो टेम्पो ल क अभ्यास तक पहुंचैत छथि ।

पिछला तीन मास स ओ तैराकी पर खास ध्यान द रहल छथि।

आगामी प्रतियोगिता हुनकऽ पहिलऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आयोजन होतै ।

पहिल बेर नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व करबाक अवसर पाबि उत्साहित छथि आ अपन क्षमताक अनुसार प्रदर्शन आ पदक लेल प्रतिस्पर्धा करबाक लेल दृढ़ संकल्पित छथि ।

सरकी लेली खाली अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता म॑ पहुँचना पहल॑ स॑ ही एगो बड़ऽ उपलब्धि छै ।

मुदा ओ अपना केँ सहभागिता धरि सीमित नहि राखय चाहैत छथि ।

जखन ओ पानि मे प्रवेश करैत छथि तऽ चाहैत छथि जे हुनकर क्षमता — अपन अतीतक पीड़ा सँ बेसी — हुनका परिभाषित करय ।

हरकमन : दुनू हाथ गमाबसँ लऽ कऽ हेलबामे पहिचान ताकब धरि

बागलुंग के 21 वर्षीय हरकमन घरती के कहानी सेहो असाधारण लचीलापन के कहानी अछि.

एगारह साल पहिने हुनकर गाम मे पहिल बेर बिजली जुटल छल। एहि क्रम मे घरती कए मेन इन्सुलेटर कए छुलाक बाद करंट लागि गेल।

दुर्घटनाक परिणामस्वरूप हुनक दुनू हाथक क्षति भेलनि ।

लेकिन शारीरिक नुकसान स॑ हुनकऽ खेल म॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करै के संकल्प कम नै होलै ।

घरती पिछला छह साल स घरेलू खेल मे सक्रिय छथि आ आब हुनका उम्मीद अछि जे ओ तैराकी क माध्यम स अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर अपन क्षमता साबित करताह।

एक साल पहिने जापान मे इंटरनेशनल एथलीट लाइसेंस प्राप्त केने छलाह।

लेकिन हुनका जकूजी सेवा आरू फिजियोथेरेपी सहित आवश्यक रिकवरी सुविधा के कमी जारी छै ।

एहि सीमा क कारण घरती क कहब अछि जे ओ आगामी प्रतियोगिता मे पदक क गारंटी नहि द सकैत छथि।

हुनकऽ महत्वाकांक्षा, लेकिन एक पदक स॑ भी आगू बढ़ी गेलऽ छै ।

हुनी भविष्य मँ ओलंपिक आरू विश्व चैंपियनशिप केरौ आयोजन मँ भाग लेबै लेली आवश्यक अनुभव आरू योग्यता के मानक जमा करना चाहै छै ।

घरती के लेल तैराकी खाली प्रतिस्पर्धा के बात नै छै। अपन शर्त पर दुनिया स परिचय कराबय के तरीका बनि गेल अछि.

जेनिशा के एकटा आओर मौका भेटैत छैक

सुदुरपश्चिम प्रांत के जेनिशा कथायत के लेल तैराकी कोनो नव यात्रा नै छै।

नौ साल स एहि खेल स जुड़ल छथि।

दसम कक्षा मे पढ़ैत काल हुनकर एकटा टांग छूटि गेलनि। तैयो ओ हेलब नहि छोड़लीह। बल्कि चुनौती क॑ प्रेरणा म॑ बदली क॑ खेल क॑ अपनऽ पहचान के हिस्सा बनैलकै ।

चीनमे आयोजित १९म एशियन खेलमे नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व कठायत कऽ चुकल अछि ।

आयोजन मे जे प्रस्तुति आशा केने छलीह से नहि द सकलीह, मुदा अनुभव हुनकर आत्मविश्वास कमजोर नहि केलक।

बल्कि नीक तैयारी कए घुरबाक संकल्प कए मजबूत केलक।

उच्च शिक्षा जारी रखैत कथ्यत प्रशिक्षण पर सेहो अपन ध्यान बनौने रखने छथि ।

एहि बेर ओ अपन पिछला अंतरराष्ट्रीय अनुभव कए बेहतर प्रदर्शन मे बदलय चाहैत छथि।

ओकर लक्ष्य स्पष्ट छैक — पदक ।

सदस्य सिंगी : दुर्घटना स स्विमिंग लेन तक

चारो एथलीटऽ म॑ सदस्य सिंगी स्यांगबो केरऽ सड़क दुर्घटना स॑ ल॑ क॑ स्विमिंग पूल तक के यात्रा भी ओतने उल्लेखनीय छै ।

17 वर्षक उम्र मे स्यांगबो चीनक संग रसुवागढ़ी सीमाक समीप सड़क दुर्घटना मे पड़ि गेल छल।

ओ नेपाली कंटेनर ट्रक मे हेल्पर के काज करैत आबि रहल छलाह आ गाड़ी चलाबय सीखैत आ अनुभव प्राप्त करैत चीन गेल छलाह.

सीमा पर अपन बारीक प्रतीक्षा मे अचानक एकटा आओर गाड़ी हुनका टक्कर मारि देलक।

दुर्घटना मे हुनकर एकटा टांग छूटि गेलनि।

दुर्घटनाक बाद जीवन सहज नहि छल।

मुदा कृत्रिम पैरक व्यवस्था करैत काल स्यांगबो हेलबाक संपर्क मे आबि गेलाह ।

कहियो तैराक बनबाक योजना नहि बनौने छलाह ।

मौका भेटलाक बाद ओ एक बेर कोशिश करबाक विचार सँ बेसी किछु नहि ल' क' पोखरि मे प्रवेश केलनि.

धीरे-धीरे तैराकी हुनक जीवनक एकटा महत्वपूर्ण अंग बनि गेलनि ।

आब 26 वर्षीय स्यांगबो सब दिन ट्रेनिंग करैत अछि। करीब दू मास स नियमित प्रशिक्षण ल रहल छथि आ कहैत छथि जे हुनकर तैयारी नीक स आगू बढ़ि रहल अछि।

तैराकी आब खाली समय बिताबय के तरीका नहिं रहि गेल अछि.

प्रतिस्पर्धा शुरू केलाक बाद हुनकर महत्वाकांक्षा बदलि गेलनि।

“घर मे मेडल आनब” आब हुनकर स्पष्ट उद्देश्य अछि ।

स्यांगबो के मानना ​​छै कि नेपाल क॑ ई बार पैरा तैराकी म॑ पदक जीतै के अच्छा मौका छै आरू वू लक्ष्य के साथ प्रशिक्षण जारी रखै छै ।

हालांकि संबंधित संस्था सब प्रशिक्षण आ दैनिक खर्च मे किछु सहयोग देलक अछि, मुदा हुनकर कहब अछि जे उच्च स्तरीय तैयारी लेल जेतना सुविधा आवश्यक अछि ओ सब उपलब्ध नहि अछि।

हुनकर आत्मविश्वास, तथापि, मजबूत बनल अछि।

चारि टा एथलीट, एक गोल

सृजना अपन पहिल अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता क तैयारी मे छथि।

जेनिशा अपनऽ पिछला अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रदर्शन म॑ सुधार करना चाहै छै ।

हरकमन केरऽ नजर भविष्य केरऽ ओलंपिक आरू विश्व चैंपियनशिप लेली क्वालीफाइंग मार्ग प॑ छै ।

सदस्य सिंगी अपनऽ पहलऽ बड़ऽ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अवसर प॑ पदक जीतना चाहै छै ।

हुनका लोकनिक कथा अलग-अलग अछि।

एकटा भूस्खलन के बाद विकलांग भ गेल। दोसर के बिजली दुर्घटना में दुनु हाथ गंवा गेल। दोसर के किशोरावस्था मे पैर गंवा देलक। चारिम के सड़क दुर्घटना मे पैर गंवा देल गेल।

मुदा दुनू गोटेक एकटा बात छनि — प्रतिस्पर्धा करबाक अटूट संकल्प ।

हुनकर सबस पैघ चुनौती सुविधा क कमी अछि।

सीमित फंडिंग, अपर्याप्त सुलभ खेल बुनियादी ढाँचा आ फिजियोथेरेपी, रिकवरी सुविधाक, उपकरण आ पोषण कें अपर्याप्त पहुंच छै.

प्रशिक्षण स्थल पर पहुंचय लेल सेहो व्यक्तिगत संघर्ष के जरूरत पड़ि सकैत अछि.

तइयो एक बेर पोखरि मे घुसि गेलाक बाद ओ कठिनाइ सभ अस्थायी रूप सँ एक कात धकेलि देल जाइत अछि ।

स्विमिंग लेन मे ओ अपन शारीरिक स्थिति सं बेसी अपन क्षमता पर ध्यान दैत छथिन्ह. हर स्ट्रोक हुनकऽ समय सुधारै के कोशिश छै, आरू हर प्रशिक्षण सत्र हुनका अंतरराष्ट्रीय मंच प॑ प्रदर्शन करै के सपना के करीब लानी दै छै ।

एकटा कोच’क चुनौती

मुख्य कोच सुबास श्रेष्ठ के लेल ई चारू एथलीट मात्र प्रतियोगी नै छैथ। ई सब महत्वपूर्ण क्षमता वाला एथलीट छैथ।

हुनकऽ दृढ़ संकल्प आरू कार्य नैतिकता मजबूत छै, लेकिन अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर प॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करै लेली नियमित आरू वैज्ञानिक प्रशिक्षण के जरूरत छै ।

जेकरा लेल समय, उपकरण, सुविधा आ आर्थिक संसाधन चाही।

सीमित संसाधन वाला एथलीट क॑ तैयार करना श्रेष्ठ लेली एगो बड़ऽ चुनौती बनलऽ छै, लेकिन ओकरऽ क्षमता ओकरा प्रेरित करै के काम जारी छै ।

हुनकऽ दृष्टिकोण छै कि एथलीटऽ के सीमा के बजाय ओकरऽ क्षमता प॑ ध्यान केंद्रित करलऽ जाय, उपलब्ध संसाधनऽ के बेहतरीन संभव उपयोग करी क॑ ओकरऽ तकनीक, समय आरू प्रदर्शन म॑ सुधार करलऽ जाय ।

मुदा, नेपाल जँ अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय पदककेँ लक्षित करय चाहैत अछि तऽ ओकर तैयारी बेसी व्यवस्थित आ दीर्घकालीन बनेबाक आवश्यकता अछि, हुनकर मानब छनि ।

पानि मे सपना

नेपाल के पैरा-स्पोर्ट्स क्षेत्र मे एखन बहुत रास रास्ता तय करय के अछि.

एकटा पदक खेलक परिदृश्य कए नहि बदलि सकैत अछि। एथलीट कें लेल निरंतर निवेश, बुनियादी ढाँचा, प्रशिक्षण आ दीर्घकालिक सहायता आवश्यक छै.

फिलहाल चारिटा एथलीट स्विमिंग पूल मे अपन भविष्य क तलाश मे छथि।

सृजना अपन पहिल अंतरराष्ट्रीय यात्रा पर अपना कए साबित करय चाहैत छथि।

हरकमन अपनऽ खेल कैरियर क॑ ओलंपिक आरू विश्व चैंपियनशिप के तरफ ले जाय चाहै छै ।

जेनिशा क॑ उम्मीद छै कि वू अपनऽ पिछला अंतरराष्ट्रीय अनुभव क॑ मजबूत प्रदर्शन म॑ बदली देतै ।

आरू सदस्य सिंगी पैर खोबै के दर्द क॑ पदक जीतै के खुशी म॑ बदलना चाहै छै ।

हुनका सभकेँ सभसँ बेसी जरूरत अछि अवसर।

मेहनत करबाक क्षमता छनि। सपना होइत छनि। आ नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व करबाक संकल्प हिनका लोकनिक अछि ।

आब सवाल ई छै कि ई चारो एथलीट कतेक मेहनत करै लेली तैयार छै, बल्कि ई भी छै कि राज्य आरू खेल प्राधिकारी कतेक सहयोग दै लेली तैयार छै ।

हुनकऽ कहानी म॑ एगो सरल संदेश छै कि शारीरिक सीमा के सपना क॑ सीमित करै के जरूरत नै छै । लेकिन वू सपना क॑ अंतरराष्ट्रीय पदक म॑ बदलै लेली अवसर, निवेश आरू सहयोग के जरूरत छै ।

full_article:
Nepal have handed the ODI captaincy back to experienced leg-spinner Sandeep Lamichhane ahead of the ACC Men’s Premier Cup in Malaysia, replacing Rohit Paudel.

The 26-year-old has previously led Nepal in 14 ODIs and returns to the role after Paudel took over in 2022.

Lamichhane has established himself as one of Nepal’s leading bowlers, reaching 150 ODI wickets faster than any other Nepalese player. He also became the first Nepal player to claim 100 wickets in T20 internationals.

Paudel enjoyed a successful spell as captain, guiding Nepal to 11 victories in 12 matches during the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 campaign and helping them secure a place in the 2023 World Cup Qualifier in Zimbabwe.

The Premier Cup will take place from August 30 to September 12, with Nepal aiming to make an impact under their returning captain.

Nepal’s squad

Sandeep Lamichhane (captain), Rohit Paudel, Aasif Sheikh, Arjun Kumal, Dev Khanal, Dipendra Singh Airee, Basir Ahamad, Ishan Pandey, Gulshan Kumar Jha, Sher Malla, Lalit Narayan Rajbanshi, Karan KC, Hemant Dhami and Sundeep Jora.

Kathmandu. The Government of Nepal has expressed deep sorrow over the human and physical damage caused by the powerful earthquake in the western part of Colombia.

Issuing a press note today, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has expressed sympathy on behalf of the Government and people of Nepal to the Government and people of Colombia, offering condolences to those who lost their lives in the earthquake and heartfelt sympathy to the bereaved families.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said, "In this difficult situation, the Government and people of Nepal stand firmly with the Government and people of Colombia." The Government of Nepal has wished for the swift and successful rescue of those missing due to the earthquake.

Nepal says it cannot locate the original 1816 Sugauli Treaty that established its boundary with British India. Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said it remains unclear whether Nepal has an official copy of the treaty signed with Britain.

Journalist Anil Giri writing in The Kathmandu Post, quoted Khanal as saying in parliament that “The Government of Nepal does not have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents. There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we do not have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties.”

Nepal, however, has documents related to the 1816 treaty and the 1950 treaties, he said. The treaty provided the basis for the demarcation of the boundary between Nepal and then British India.

The original copy of the treaty has been missing since 2016 when the Eminent Persons Group began discussions on revising the 1950 Treaty of Peace & Friendship between India and Nepal. Kathmandu, it seems, has been using a copy of the original.

It triggered a parliamentary inquiry which found that even the original of the Treaty of Peace & Friendship was missing. In 2019, then foreign minister Pradeep Gyawali was quoted as saying that “We have both treaties, but we have to forensically verify whether these copies are originals or not. We are also trying to find historical documents and maps in India and the United Kingdom.”

The Treaty of Sugauli signed by Nepal and the East India Company required the former to cede large amounts of territory following its defeat in the Anglo-Nepal War. The Treaty of Friendship signed by the then Rana government of Nepal and India granted Indian and Nepalis reciprocal rights in either country.

While derided as “unequal” by various sections in Nepal, the treaty helped shape the relationship between Nepal and India.

नेपाल के कहनाय छनि जे ओ मूल 1816 के सुगौली संधि के पता नहि लगा सकैत अछि जे ब्रिटिश भारत सं अपन सीमा स्थापित केने छल. विदेश मंत्री शिसिर खनाल कहलनि जे, ब्रिटेन के संग हस्ताक्षरित संधि के आधिकारिक प्रति नेपाल लग अछि कि नहि से एखन धरि स्पष्ट नहि अछि।

पत्रकार अनिल गिरी द काठमांडू पोस्ट मे लिखैत, संसद मे खनालक उद्धृत करैत कहलनि जे, “नेपाल सरकार लग एहि बातक स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे हमरा सब लग आधिकारिक संधि दस्तावेज अछि कि नहि। एहन अभिलेख अछि जे किछु खास संधि स संबंधित किछु दस्तावेज राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार मे राखल जाइत अछि।मुदा हमरा सब लग स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे ओ वास्तविक आधिकारिक संधि अछि या नहि।”

ओना नेपाल मे १८१६ के संधि आ १९५० के संधि स संबंधित दस्तावेज अछि ओ कहलनि । ई संधि नेपाल आ तत्कालीन ब्रिटिश भारत के बीच सीमा के सीमांकन के आधार प्रदान केलक ।

संधि केरऽ मूल प्रति २०१६ स॑ गायब छै जब॑ ईमिनेंट पर्सन ग्रुप न॑ १९५० केरऽ भारत आरू नेपाल के बीच शांति आरू मैत्री संधि म॑ संशोधन करै के चर्चा शुरू करलकै । काठमांडू, बुझाइत अछि, मूलक प्रतिलिपि प्रयोग करैत आबि रहल अछि ।

एकरा स॑ संसदीय जांच शुरू होय गेलै जेकरा म॑ पता चललै कि शांति आरू दोस्ती केरऽ संधि केरऽ मूल भी गायब छै । 2019 में तत्कालीन विदेश मंत्री प्रदीप ज्ञानवाली के हवाला स कहल गेल छल जे “हमरा सब लग दुनू संधि अछि, मुदा हमरा सब के फोरेंसिक तरीका स सत्यापन करय पड़त जे ई प्रति सब मूल अछि या नै। हम सब भारत आ यूनाइटेड किंगडम में ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज आ नक्शा सेहो खोजय के कोशिश में छी।”

नेपाल आ ईस्ट इंडिया कम्पनी द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित सुगौली संधि मे आँग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध मे पराजित भेलाक बाद पूर्व केँ पैघ मात्रा मे क्षेत्र सौंपबाक आवश्यकता छल । नेपाल आ भारतक तत्कालीन राणा सरकार द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित मैत्री संधि मे भारतीय आ नेपाली केँ दुनू देश मे पारस्परिक अधिकार प्रदान कयल गेल छल |

नेपाल के विभिन्न वर्ग द्वारा “असमान” के रूप में उपहास करला के साथ ही ई संधि नेपाल आरू भारत के बीच के संबंध के आकार दै में मदद करलकै ।

full_article:
Footage of men climbing to the top of a mosque's minaret and attempting to hoist a saffron flag has been falsely shared in social media posts claiming it shows Hindus vandalising a mosque during religious violence in southern Nepal in late July 2026. The footage has circulated since February 2020, and in fact shows a mosque that was vandalised in Delhi's Ashok Nagar area during deadly sectarian clashes.

"After Muslim jihadist extremists pelted stones at a Hindu procession, Hindus became furious and vandalised a mosque before setting it on fire," says part of the Hindi-language caption of a Facebook video shared on August 1, 2026.

The video shows men ripping off the muezzin's loudspeaker on top of the mosque's minaret and placing a Hindu religious flag and an Indian flag.

Screenshot of the false post captured on August 5, 2026, with a red X added by AFP

The clip also circulated in similar Instagram and X posts as violence between Hindu and Muslim communities in several towns in southern Nepal left at least three people dead and dozens injured ( archived link).

Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah, who has kept a low profile since being elected in March, broke his silence to deliver his first address to the nation, calling on his countrymen to be "responsible citizens and remove the clouds of unrest".

The circulating video, however, is several years old and in fact occurred in India's capital New Delhi.

title: Nepal Mobility Expo-2026 gets rolling - The Rising Nepal
description: Nepal Mobility Expo-2026 gets rolling  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 11: The Nepal Mobility Expo-2026 has commenced today at local Bhrikuti Mandap.

Inaugurating the Expo, Nepal Police Inspector General Dhan Bahadur Karki said there should be cooperation between the transport and mobility sectors for economic development.

“I believe exhibitions like this can serve as a milestone in the development of Nepal's transportation and mobility sector. It is necessary to focus on aspects like road safety, traffic management, and vehicle discipline. If we move forward with coordination and cooperation between regulatory bodies and stakeholders, the transportation sector can be organized,” he said.

Ritu Singh Vaidya, president of the Nepal Automobile Importers and Manufacturers Association (NAIMA), said that vehicles of different models were displayed under the same roof.

Eighteen new brands of two-wheelers and 29 new brands of four-wheelers are being unveiled at the expo running from August 11 to 16.

Anjan Shrestha, President of the Federation of Nepalese Chambers of Commerce and Industry, Birendra Raj Pandey, President of the Confederation of Nepalese Industries, Punya Prasad Sitoula (Saroj), President of the Federation of Nepalese National Transport Entrepreneurs, and Kamalesh Agrawal, President of the Nepal Chamber of Commerce, all expressed the view that the transport sector needs to be made systematic and disciplined.(RSS)

नेपाल ऑटोमोबाइल आयातक तथा निर्माता संघ (नायमा)के अध्यक्ष ऋतुसिंह वैद्य एकहि छत के नीचा विभिन्न मॉडलके वाहन प्रदर्शित कएल गेल बतौलनि ।

DHAKA, Aug 11, 2026 (BSS)- Nepalese defender Bimala BK has arrived in the capital today (Tuesday) to join Bangladesh Women's Football League champions Rajshahi Stars FC for their historic AFC Women's Champions League campaign.

Bimala was received at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport by Rajshahi Stars' team manager and assistant coach. She is returning to the club for a second spell and said she was proud to have the opportunity to represent Rajshahi and Bangladesh in one of Asia's biggest women's club competitions.

“I am happy to be playing for Rajshahi for the second time. I am even more excited to play in the AFC competition.

It’s great honour to compete on such a big stage, especially as Rajshahi and Bangladesh are appearing in the competition for the first time,” Bimala said.

Despite the limited preparation time and respecting the strength of opponents, she has expressed her firm determination to give her best in the match.

"We don’t take our opponents lightly, but that does not mean we are weak either. We want to win every match, become group champions and advance to the next round. We need your support for that,” said the Nepalese defender.

title: 9 Deaths From Japanese Encephalitis in Nepal - Ratopati
description: 9 Deaths From Japanese Encephalitis in Nepal  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. In a period of 55 days, 9 people have died from Japanese Encephalitis across Nepal.

The Department of Health Services has stated that 46 people across the country have been infected with Japanese Encephalitis.

Also Read 9 people died from Japanese Encephalitis

An edited excerpt of the conversation with Dr. Abhiyan Gautam, Chief of the Child Health and Vaccination Service Branch under the Family Welfare Division of the Department, in this regard-

In a period of two months, 9 people died from Japanese Encephalitis across the country. What is the death rate in Nepal?

In the months of Asar and Saun, infection of this disease has been confirmed in 46 people, of whom 9 have already died. Compared to previous years, the death rate from this disease has increased this year.

What kind of environment and medium are considered favorable for the spread of Japanese Encephalitis?

Areas with high temperatures and stagnant water in the Terai and inner Madhesh regions, where paddy cultivation is done, are favorable environments for this disease. The 'Culex' mosquito lays eggs in stagnant paddy fields or ponds as a medium of infection. The cycle of infection involves pigs, swine, and ducks as 'amplifying hosts', where the number of viruses increases rapidly and quantitatively. When a mosquito that has bitten an infected pig or duck bites a human, the disease is transmitted to humans.

How to differentiate the symptoms of seasonal fever or flu and Japanese Encephalitis?

Seasonal fever involves common cold, cough, and fever. However, the symptoms of Japanese Encephalitis are very severe and serious. High fever, unbearable headache, changes in consciousness level, and gradual unconsciousness are symptoms of Japanese Encephalitis. Affected individuals may fall into a coma and require ICU or ventilator support.

How is it treated?

There is no specific antiviral medicine for Japanese Encephalitis. 'Supportive treatment' (treatment according to symptoms) is given based on the patient's condition. The patient may be given oxygen or ventilator support. If reached to the hospital quickly, complications and death can be avoided, and if delayed, there is a high risk of death due to severe brain damage (its mortality rate is about 30 percent).

What is the role of vaccination in preventing this disease and who is eligible?

This vaccine is given to children as part of the regular vaccination program, to children who have completed 12 months. Children up to 5 years of age can get it if they have missed it. Since vaccination has reached children, this disease is seen very rarely in children under 15 years of age. Currently, there is no regular vaccination system for adults. However, the government has conducted vaccination campaigns in high-risk areas (like Nawalpur). 95 to 100 percent of vaccinated people appear to be safe from its severe effects and death.

What personal and community-level precautions should be taken to prevent infection?

When going out, wear long-sleeved clothes, use a mosquito net compulsorily when sleeping at night, install nets on windows and doors, or use mosquito repellent incense or creams. Mosquitoes that transmit Japanese Encephalitis especially bite from evening to night and early morning. Pig, swine, and duck pens should be kept away from the house. Nets should be installed around the pens or an environment that repels mosquitoes should be created.

Does eating meat from infected pigs or ducks also transmit Japanese Encephalitis?

No. This disease is not transmitted by eating meat. It is a disease transmitted only by the bite of an infected mosquito.

What is the preparedness of hospitals in Nepal for the treatment of Japanese Encephalitis patients?

Primary testing and treatment facilities are available in district-level hospitals. Arrangements have been made to transfer seriously ill patients who require ICU or ventilator support to provincial or federal hospitals immediately for treatment.

काठमांडू। ५५ दिनक अवधिमे सम्पूर्ण नेपालमे जापानी इन्सेफेलाइटिससँ ९ गोटेके मृत्यु भेल अछि ।

स्वास्थ्य सेवा विभाग के कहनाय छनि जे देश भरि मे 46 लोक जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस सं संक्रमित भ गेल छथिन्ह.

Also Read जापानी इन्सेफेलाइटिस सँ ९ गोटेक मृत्यु भेल अछि

विभाग के परिवार कल्याण प्रभाग के अंतर्गत बाल स्वास्थ्य एवं टीकाकरण सेवा शाखा के प्रमुख डॉ. अभियान गौतम के साथ इस संबंध में बातचीत का एक संपादित अंश-

दू महीना के अवधि में देश भर में जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस सं 9 लोक के मौत भ गेल. नेपालमे मृत्यु दर कितने अछि ?

असर आ सौन के महीना में 46 गोटे में एहि बीमारी के संक्रमण के पुष्टि भ चुकल अछि, जाहि में 9 गोटे के मौत भ चुकल अछि। पिछला साल क तुलना मे एहि साल एहि बीमारी स मौत क दर बढ़ल अछि।

जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ के प्रसार के लेल कोन तरहक वातावरण आ माध्यम अनुकूल मानल जाइत अछि ?

तराई आरू भीतरी मधेश क्षेत्रऽ म॑ अधिक तापमान आरू ठमकल पानी वाला क्षेत्र, जहां धान के खेती होय छै, ई बीमारी लेली अनुकूल वातावरण छै । ‘क्यूलेक्स’ मच्छर संक्रमण के माध्यम के रूप में ठहरल धान के खेत या पोखरि में अंडा दैत अछि | संक्रमण कें चक्र मे सुअर, सुअर, आ बतख कें ‘प्रवर्धन मेजबान’ कें रूप मे शामिल कैल जायत छै, जत वायरस कें संख्या तेजी सं आ मात्रात्मक रूप सं बढ़यत छै. संक्रमित सुअर या बतहा कें काटि लेने वाला मच्छर जखन मनुष्य कें काटएयत छै तखन इ बीमारी मनुष्यक मे संक्रमित भ जायत छै.

मौसमी बुखार या फ्लू आ जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ के लक्षण में कोना अंतर कयल जाय ?

मौसमी बुखार मे आम सर्दी, खांसी, आ बुखार शामिल छै. मुदा, जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथक लक्षण बहुत गंभीर आ गंभीर होइत छैक । तेज बुखार, असहनीय माथ दर्द, चेतनाक स्तर मे परिवर्तन, आ धीरे-धीरे बेहोशी जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथक लक्षण थिक । प्रभावित व्यक्ति कोमा मे आबि सकएय छै आ आईसीयू या वेंटिलेटर कें सहायता कें आवश्यकता भ सकएय छै.

एकर इलाज कोना होइत छैक ?

जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस कें लेल कोनों विशिष्ट एंटीवायरल दवाई नहि छै. रोगी कें स्थिति कें आधार पर ‘सहायक उपचार’ (लक्षणक कें अनुसार उपचार) देल जायत छै. रोगी कें ऑक्सीजन या वेंटिलेटर कें सहायता देल जा सकएय छै. यदि जल्दी अस्पताल पहुंचल जाय त जटिलता आ मौत सं बचल जा सकएय छै, आ अगर देरी भ जायत छै त मस्तिष्क कें गंभीर क्षति कें कारण मौत कें खतरा बेसि होयत छै (एकर मृत्यु दर लगभग 30 प्रतिशत छै) ।

अइ बीमारी कें रोकथाम मे टीकाकरण कें की भूमिका छै आ के पात्र छै?

इ टीका नियमित टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम कें हिस्साक कें रूप मे बच्चाक कें देल जायत छै, ओय बच्चाक कें जे 12 महीना पूरा करएयत छै. 5 साल तइक कें बच्चाक कें इ मिल सकएय छै अगर ओ एकरा छूटल छै. चूँकि टीकाकरण बच्चाक कें पास पहुंच गेल छै, अइ कें लेल इ बीमारी 15 साल सं कम उम्र कें बच्चाक मे बहुत कम देखल जायत छै. फिलहाल वयस्कक कें लेल नियमित टीकाकरण प्रणाली नहि छै. मुदा सरकार उच्च जोखिम वाला इलाका (जैना नवलपुर) मे टीकाकरण अभियान चला देलक अछि। टीकाकृत 95 सं 100 प्रतिशत लोग एकर गंभीर प्रभाव आ मौत सं सुरक्षित देखायत छै.

संक्रमण सं बचाव कें लेल व्यक्तिगत आ समुदाय स्तर कें की सावधानी बरतबाक चाही?

बाहर निकलएय कें समय लंबा बाजू कें कपड़ा पहनूं, रात मे सुतएय कें समय अनिवार्य रूप सं मच्छरदानी कें उपयोग करूं, खिड़की आ दरवाजाक पर जाल लगाऊं, या मच्छर भगाएय वाला धूप या क्रीम कें उपयोग करूं. जापानी इंसेफेलाइटिस कें संक्रमण करएय वाला मच्छर विशेष रूप सं सांझ सं राति आ भोरे-भोर कें काटएयत छै. सुग्गर, सुअर, आ बतहाक कें गोला घर सं दूर राखल जेबाक चाही. पेन कें चारू कात जाल लगाएल जेबाक चाही या मच्छर कें भगाएय वाला वातावरण बनावा जैबाक चाही.

की संक्रमित सुअर या बतहा कें मांस खाएय सं जापानी मस्तिष्कशोथ कें संक्रमण सेहो होयत छै?

नहि ई रोग मांस खएला सँ नहि होइत अछि । इ एकटा एहन बीमारी छै जे केवल संक्रमित मच्छर कें काटला सं संक्रमित होयत छै.

जापानी इन्सेफेलाइटिस के मरीज के इलाज के लेल नेपाल के अस्पताल के की तैयारी अछि ?

जिला स्तरीय अस्पताल मे प्राथमिक जांच आ इलाज कें सुविधा उपलब्ध छै. गंभीर रूप सं बीमार मरीज कें इलाज कें लेल तुरंत प्रांतीय या संघीय अस्पताल मे स्थानांतरित करय कें व्यवस्था कैल गेल छै.

title: Nepal Police Prioritizes Tech-Based Investigation to Curb Online Misinformation and Fraud - Ratopati
description: Nepal Police Prioritizes Tech-Based Investigation to Curb Online Misinformation and Fraud  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. As incidents of fake news, misleading information, 'deepfakes', 'hate speech', and cyber fraud spreading through social media increase, Nepal Police has prioritized a technology-friendly investigation and monitoring system to control such activities.

Inspector General of Nepal Police, Dan Bahadur Karki, stated that the police are aware that the misuse of social media can disrupt goodwill among citizens and pose challenges to peace and security. According to him, the police are further strengthening their manpower and technology to control the negative activities arising from the use of social media.

He said that preparations are being made to equip the Cyber Bureau with more resources and deploy skilled manpower in technology for monitoring and investigating such activities. The police are also making the monitoring of social media activities effective through the 'Advanced Analytics Cell'.

"The police have prioritized identifying the source of such content and bringing it under the legal framework, as fake and misleading information, deepfakes, and hate speech spread on social media can affect social harmony," said Inspector General Karki. "For this, coordination has also been done with relevant service providers, government agencies, and other stakeholders."

According to him, along with the misuse of social media, online fraud has also become a major challenge for the police in recent times. He expressed confidence that the police will be able to control incidents of fraud such as tricking people by claiming they have won online lotteries, asking for personal and banking details in the name of KYC updates, withdrawing money by taking OTPs, and committing financial fraud through various temptations.

Inspector General Karki informed that the police have been carrying out public awareness campaigns along with investigations and actions to control such crimes. The police have been urging citizens not to believe messages claiming they have won a lottery when they have not participated, not to give OTPs to unknown individuals, and not to provide personal details based on calls claiming to be from banks or financial institutions.

According to Inspector General Karki, a concept to establish an 'Anti Cyber Scam Center' is also being advanced to control cyber fraud. He informed that the proposed mechanism will involve coordination between banks and financial institutions, Nepal Rastra Bank, police, and the telecommunication sector to enable immediate response as soon as a victim realizes they have been defrauded.

He expressed the belief that by receiving immediate information about cyber fraud incidents, criminal activities can be reduced. He stated that a system will be developed to receive information quickly through various means and mobilize the relevant agencies.

Similarly, the police are preparing to develop an 'Immediate Financial Fraud Reporting System' or e-reporting system. Through this system, citizens can immediately provide information to the police if they are defrauded. The goal is to minimize financial losses from fraud by coordinating between the concerned banks and financial institutions, telecommunication service providers, and the police as soon as information is received.

The police have also prioritized international cooperation in cybercrime investigation. Since most of the infrastructure of social media and digital service providers is located outside Nepal, Inspector General Karki said that investigations are being carried out in coordination with the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol), police forces of various countries, and relevant technology service providers.

In the process of expanding the use of technology to control the misuse of social media, preparations are being made to gradually connect surveillance cameras installed in public places with artificial intelligence (AI). He informed that there is a plan to use AI in crowded places for technologies such as facial recognition.

The police have emphasized controlling criminal activities, investigation, and legal action resulting from the misuse of social media. Inspector General Karki stated that as technology develops, the nature of crime also changes, and traditional policing methods alone cannot cope with new challenges.

The police have urged citizens to use social media responsibly, as false information and rumors spread through social media can create distrust and tension among citizens. According to the police, re-broadcasting information on social media without verifying its authenticity as soon as it is received is also a cause of the problem.

The police have pointed out the need to expand awareness about the responsible use of social media from the school level. The police have concluded that digital crime and misuse can only be controlled through the cooperation of citizens, media, social media users, service providers, and security agencies.

महानिरीक्षक कार्की नँ कहलकै कि पुलिस नँ ऐसनौ सामग्री के स्रोत के पहचान करी क ओकरा कानूनी ढाँचा मँ लानै क प्राथमिकता देलकै, कैन्हेंकि सोशल मीडिया प फैललौ फर्जी आरू भ्रामक जानकारी, डीपफेक, आरू नफरत के भाषण सामाजिक सौहार्द क प्रभावित करी सकै छै । "एकरा लेली संबंधित सेवा प्रदाता, सरकारी एजेंसी, आरू अन्य हितधारकऽ के साथ भी समन्वय करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।"

हुनकऽ अनुसार सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग के साथ-साथ ऑनलाइन धोखाधड़ी भी हाल के समय म॑ पुलिस लेली एगो बड़ऽ चुनौती बनी गेलऽ छै । ओ विश्वास जतौलनि जे पुलिस ऑनलाइन लॉटरी जीतबाक दावा कए लोक कए छल करब, केवाईसी अपडेट क नाम पर व्यक्तिगत आ बैंकिंग विवरण मांगब, ओटीपी ल कए पैसा निकालब, आ विभिन्न प्रलोभन क माध्यम स वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी करब जेहन धोखाधड़ी क घटना कए नियंत्रित करबा मे सक्षम होएत।

महानिरीक्षक कार्की जानकारी देलनि जे पुलिस एहि तरहक अपराध पर नियंत्रण करबाक लेल जांच आ कार्रवाईक संग जन जागरूकता अभियान सेहो चला रहल अछि। पुलिस नागरिक सब स आग्रह करैत रहल अछि जे जखन ओ भाग नहि लेने छथि तखन लॉटरी जीतबाक दावा करय वाला संदेश पर विश्वास नहि करथि, अनजान व्यक्ति के ओटीपी नहि देथि, आ बैंक या वित्तीय संस्थान के फोन के आधार पर व्यक्तिगत जानकारी नहि देथि।

महानिरीक्षक कार्की के अनुसार साइबर धोखाधड़ी पर नियंत्रण के लेल ‘एंटी साइबर घोटाला केंद्र’ के स्थापना के अवधारणा सेहो आगू बढ़ाओल जा रहल अछि। ओ जानकारी देलनि जे प्रस्तावित तंत्र मे बैंक आ वित्तीय संस्था, नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक, पुलिस, आ दूरसंचार क्षेत्रक बीच समन्वय शामिल होयत जाहि सँ पीड़ित केँ ठकबाक अहसास होइते तत्काल प्रतिक्रिया संभव होयत।

हुनी ई विश्वास व्यक्त करलकै कि साइबर धोखाधड़ी के घटना के तुरंत जानकारी मिलला स॑ आपराधिक गतिविधि म॑ कमी ​​आबी सकै छै । ओ कहलनि जे, विभिन्न माध्यम सं सूचना जल्दी सं प्राप्त करय आ संबंधित एजेंसी के जुटाबय के व्यवस्था बनाओल जायत.

तहिना पुलिस ‘तत्काल वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी रिपोर्टिंग प्रणाली’ या ई रिपोर्टिंग प्रणाली विकसित करबाक तैयारी मे अछि। एहि प्रणाली के माध्यम सं नागरिक धोखाधड़ी भेला पर तुरंत पुलिस के जानकारी द सकय छथिन्ह. लक्ष्य छै कि जानकारी मिलतें ही संबंधित बैंक आरू वित्तीय संस्थान, दूरसंचार सेवा प्रदाता, आरू पुलिस के बीच समन्वय करी क॑ धोखाधड़ी स॑ होय वाला आर्थिक नुकसान क॑ कम स॑ कम करलऽ जाय ।

पुलिस साइबर अपराध के जांच मे अंतरराष्ट्रीय सहयोग के सेहो प्राथमिकता देलक अछि. सोशल मिडिया आ डिजिटल सेवा प्रदाता के अधिकांश बुनियादी ढांचा नेपाल स बाहर रहला स महानिरीक्षक कार्की कहला जे अंतरराष्ट्रीय आपराधिक पुलिस संगठन (इंटरपोल), विभिन्न देश क पुलिस बल, आ संबंधित प्रौद्योगिकी सेवा प्रदाता क संग समन्वय क जांच भ रहल अछि।

सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग पर नियंत्रण के लेल तकनीक के उपयोग के विस्तार के प्रक्रिया में सार्वजनिक स्थान पर लगाओल गेल निगरानी कैमरा के धीरे-धीरे आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (एआई) सं जोड़य के तैयारी भ रहल अछि. ओ जानकारी देलनि जे फेशियल रिकग्निशन जेहन तकनीक लेल भीड़भाड़ वाला जगह पर एआई के उपयोग करबाक योजना अछि।

पुलिस सोशल मीडिया के दुरुपयोग के परिणामस्वरूप आपराधिक गतिविधि, जांच, आ कानूनी कार्रवाई पर नियंत्रण पर जोर देलक अछि. महानिरीक्षक कार्की नँ कहलकै कि जेना-जेना तकनीक के विकास होय छै, अपराध के प्रकृति भी बदलै छै, आरू पारंपरिक पुलिसिंग के तरीका ही नया चुनौती के सामना नै करी सकै छै ।

पुलिस नागरिक सब स सोशल मीडिया के जिम्मेदारी स उपयोग करबाक आग्रह केलक अछि, कियाक त सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स गलत जानकारी आ अफवाह फैलल नागरिक के बीच अविश्वास आ तनाव पैदा भ सकैत अछि। पुलिस के अनुसार सूचना मिलैत देरी बिना ओकर प्रामाणिकता के सत्यापन केने सोशल मीडिया पर फेर सं प्रसारित करब सेहो समस्या के कारण अछि.

पुलिस स्कूल स्तर सं सोशल मीडिया के जिम्मेदार उपयोग के बारे मे जागरूकता बढ़ाबय के जरूरत के ओर इशारा केलक अछि. पुलिस न॑ ई निष्कर्ष निकाललकै कि डिजिटल अपराध आरू दुरुपयोग प॑ नागरिक, मीडिया, सोशल मीडिया यूजर, सेवा प्रदाता, आरू सुरक्षा एजेंसी के सहयोग स॑ ही नियंत्रण करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

full_article:
The International Labour Organization (ILO) welcomes and commends the Government of Nepal on its ratification of two landmark ILO instruments: the Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (Protocol No. 29) and the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (Convention No. 81), following their adoption by the Federal Parliament. The instruments of ratification were formally deposited during a ceremony held at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

© Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. © Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. Nepal deposited the instruments of ratification of the Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (Protocol No. 29) and the Labour Inspection Convention, 1947 (Convention No. 81) at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

The ILO also recognizes the leadership and collective efforts of the Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav, Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment (MoYLE), the concerned ministries, parliamentarians, workers' and employers' organizations, and all social partners in advancing these ratifications.

Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav said, "The ratification of these two ILO instruments reaffirms Nepal's commitment to promoting decent work, safeguarding workers' rights, and strengthening protections against forced labour. It will further strengthen our existing labour system and enhance our efforts to prevent exploitation, improve labour inspection, and ensure that labour rights are effectively protected and upheld."

© File photo © File photo Hon. Minister Ramjee Yadav, Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment (MoYLE), presenting the proposal to Parliament for approval of the ratification of the Conventions.

By ratifying Convention No. 81, Nepal will strengthen its labour inspection system to better ensure safe, healthy and decent working conditions for all workers. Effective labour inspection is essential for enforcing labour laws, promoting compliance and protecting workers' rights across all sectors of the economy.

The Convention will improve the enforcement of laws on wages, working time, occupational safety and health, child labour and other fundamental labour protections, helping ensure that workers' rights are upheld not only in legislation but also in factories, shops, construction sites, service workplaces and other places of work.

The ratification of Protocol No. 29 will strengthen Nepal's efforts to prevent and eliminate forced labour, protect victims, ensure access to justice and remedies, including compensation and legal assistance, and address trafficking in persons for forced labour. It will support stronger measures to identify, release, protect and rehabilitate victims, including migrant workers and people in vulnerable situations.

© Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. © Permanent Mission of Nepal in Geneva. H.E. Ambassador Ram Prasad Subedi, Permanent Representative of Nepal in Geneva, deposited the Instruments of Ratification with Gilbert F. Houngbo, ILO Director-General, during a ceremony held at ILO Headquarters in Geneva on 7 August 2026.

"This is a proud and significant moment for Nepal," said Numan Özcan, ILO Country Director for Nepal. "By advancing these two instruments, the Government is sending a clear message that every worker matters. Their ratification will help turn the promise of decent work into a lived reality. I congratulate the Government of Nepal and all those who contributed to this important milestone through their leadership, commitment and collaboration."

As Nepal prepares for graduation from Least Developed Country (LDC) status and explores future trade opportunities, including possible access to the European Union's GSP+ framework, strong labour standards and their effective implementation will be increasingly important to protect workers and support sustainable economic growth.

Effective labour inspection benefits workers, responsible employers and the national economy alike. Fair and consistent enforcement helps create a level playing field for businesses, reduce labour disputes, prevent workplace accidents and abuse, promote productivity, and strengthen confidence in the rule of law. Likewise, eliminating forced labour contributes to poverty reduction, the formalization of employment and Nepal's vision of inclusive and sustainable prosperity founded on decent work.

By ratifying these two instruments, Nepal has taken an important step towards a future in which no one is subjected to forced labour, every worker enjoys effective protection under the law, and every workplace upholds dignity, safety and justice.

The ILO stands ready to continue working with the Government of Nepal, employers' and workers' organizations, civil society and development partners to support the effective implementation of these commitments.

सम्मेलन नम्बर ८१ के अनुमोदन क नेपाल अपन श्रम निरीक्षण प्रणाली के मजबूत करत जाहि स सब मजदूर के सुरक्षित, स्वस्थ आ सभ्य काज के स्थिति बेहतर ढंग स सुनिश्चित होयत। श्रम कानून कें लागू करय, अनुपालन कें बढ़ावा देवय आ अर्थव्यवस्था कें सब क्षेत्रक मे श्रमिकक कें अधिकारक कें सुरक्षा कें लेल प्रभावी श्रम निरीक्षण आवश्यक छै.

इ महासन्धि मजदूरी, काम कें समय, व्यावसायिक सुरक्षा आ स्वास्थ्य, बाल श्रम आ अन्य मौलिक श्रम संरक्षणक कें कानून कें प्रवर्तन मे सुधार करतय, जे इ सुनिश्चित करय मे मदद करतय कि श्रमिकक कें अधिकारक कें न केवल कानून मे बल्कि फैक्ट्री, दुकान, निर्माण स्थल, सेवा कार्यस्थल आ अन्य कार्यस्थल मे सेहो कायम राखल जाय.

title: Nepal make major changes to squad ahead of ACC Premier Cup - Khabarhub
description: Nepal make major changes to squad ahead of ACC Premier Cup  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) has made major changes to the national cricket squad after the team’s disappointing performance during its Netherlands tour under the ICC World Cup League-2.

Ahead of the upcoming ACC Premier Cup, CAN has dropped several senior and experienced players and opted to give opportunities to younger players.

According to CAN’s latest decision, senior pacer Sompal Kami, all-rounder Aarif Sheikh, Bhim Sharki, Binod Bhandari and Nandan Yadav have been left out of both the senior and Nepal ‘A’ squads.

Regular opener Kushal Bhurtel, meanwhile, has been demoted from the senior squad to the Nepal ‘A’ team.

Following the team’s below-par performance in the Netherlands, CAN has prioritised young players in both the batting and bowling departments.

Young batters Dev Khanal and Sundeep Jora, along with left-arm spin all-rounder Basir Ahmed, have secured places in the senior squad.

Mystery spinner Sher Malla, who has impressed in domestic cricket, has also been included in the ODI national squad for the first time.

The latest squad reshuffle comes after Nepal’s continued underwhelming performances and is being viewed as a strong signal of CAN’s intention to introduce fresh thinking, increase competition within the team and prepare for the future.

Kushal Bhurtel, Sompal Kami, Bhim Sharki, Nandan Yadav, Aarif Sheikh and Binod Bhandari have been dropped from the senior team.

Meanwhile, young players Dev Khanal, Sher Malla, Sundeep Jora and Basir Ahmed have been brought into the senior squad.

title: Rajendra Bimal, literary scholar who sought common ground across Nepal’s divides, dies at 80 - kathmandupost.com
description: Rajendra Bimal, literary scholar who sought common ground across Nepal’s divides, dies at 80  kathmandupost.com
publisher.title: kathmandupost.com
full_article:
Rajendra Bimal believed that literature could do what politics often failed to do: bring people divided by language, geography and identity into the same conversation.

For decades, the writer, scholar and linguist made that belief the organising principle of his intellectual life. From Janakpur, where he was based for much of his career, Bimal wrote across Nepali, Maithili, Hindi and English, while arguing for a sense of belonging that was larger than any single region, community or language.

Bimal died on Tuesday morning in Janakpur. He was 80.

His oxygen level and pulse dropped suddenly late Monday night, according to his family. He was taken to a local hospital, where he died while undergoing treatment.

To his peers, Bimal was more than a prolific writer. He was an interpreter between Nepal’s literary and linguistic worlds, particularly at a time when questions of identity and belonging were becoming increasingly contested. His work sought neither to erase difference nor to privilege one identity over another, but to find the common ground beneath them.

Born on March 26, 1947, at Devi Chowk in Janakpur-10, Bimal began writing when he was barely 12, publishing his first short story in a Hindi daily. His early interest in languages developed into a lifelong intellectual pursuit. He earned master’s degrees in Nepali, Hindi and Maithili and later completed a doctorate in linguistics.

In 1973, he joined Tribhuvan University as a lecturer of Nepali, beginning an academic career that would span decades. Alongside teaching and scholarship, he produced stories, novels, essays, songs and ghazals in four languages. His writing found its way into classrooms as well as literary circles, giving his ideas an audience beyond the world of academia.

For Bimal, the promotion of Maithili did not mean retreating into linguistic or regional particularism. As founding chairman of the Maithili Development Fund, he worked to preserve and advance the language and its literary traditions while maintaining strong links with the wider Nepali literary establishment.

That bridging role was central to his public life. He became a voice for a broader Nepali identity, one that recognised the country’s linguistic and cultural diversity without allowing those differences to become barriers to dialogue.

His contribution to language and literature earned him the Jagadamba Shree Award in 2010, in recognition of his work helping Maithili-speaking students learn Nepali and his contribution to Nepal’s multilingual literary landscape. He received the Madhupark Honour in 2019.

Surendra Labh, chief of Madhesh Province, described his death as an irreparable loss to the country’s intellectual wealth.

Analyst Chandra Kishore remembered him as a foundational figure in cultural dialogue, particularly for his ability to offer a voice of reason and harmony during periods of social and political fragmentation.

Bimal’s life and work were rooted in Janakpur, but his concerns were never confined to it. He spent his career asking how a country as diverse as Nepal could speak to itself without allowing differences of language, ethnicity or geography to become walls.

His final rites were performed with state honours at the Swargadwari crematorium in Janakpur. His funeral procession passed through several parts of the city and drew federal and provincial ministers, Province Chief Labh, lawmakers, local officials and a large gathering of mourners.

Bimal is survived by two sons and a daughter.

राजेन्द्र बिमल के मानना ​​छेलै कि साहित्य वू काम करी सकै छै जे राजनीति अक्सर असफल होय जाय छै: भाषा, भूगोल आरू पहचान के आधार पर बंटलऽ लोगऽ क॑ एक ही बातचीत म॑ लानी ।

दशकों तक साहित्यकार, विद्वान आ भाषाविद ओहि मान्यता के अपन बौद्धिक जीवन के संगठित सिद्धांत बनौलनि । जनकपुर सँ, जतय ओ अपन कैरियरक अधिकांश समय धरि स्थित छलाह, बिमल नेपाली, मैथिली, हिन्दी आ अंग्रेजी भरि मे लिखैत छलाह, संगहि कोनो एक क्षेत्र, समुदाय वा भाषा सँ पैघ अपनत्वक भावक तर्क दैत छलाह ।

मंगलदिन भोर जनकपुरमे बिमलके मृत्यु भेल अछि । ओ 80 वर्षक छलाह।

हुनकर परिवार के अनुसार सोमदिन देर राति हुनकर ऑक्सीजन के स्तर आ नाड़ी में अचानक गिरावट आयल। हुनका स्थानीय अस्पताल ल गेल गेल, जतय हुनकर इलाज के दौरान मौत भ गेल।

अपन समवयस्क लेल बिमल एकटा प्रखर साहित्यकार स बेसी छलाह । नेपाल केरऽ साहित्यिक आरू भाषाई दुनिया के बीच व्याख्याकार छेलै, खास करी क॑ वू समय म॑ जब॑ पहचान आरू अपनऽ होय के सवालऽ प॑ तेजी स॑ मुकाबला होय रहलऽ छेलै । हुनकऽ काम नै त॑ अंतर क॑ मेटै के कोशिश करलकै आरू नै एक पहचान क॑ दोसरऽ पहचान प॑ विशेषाधिकार दै के कोशिश करलकै, बल्कि ओकरा नीचें के समानता के खोज करै के कोशिश करलकै ।

जनकपुर-10 के देवी चौक पर 26 मार्च 1947 के जन्मल बिमल मुश्किल स 12 साल के उम्र में लेखन शुरू केलनि, पहिल लघुकथा हिन्दी दैनिक में प्रकाशित केलनि। भाषा में हुनकऽ प्रारंभिक रुचि आजीवन बौद्धिक साधना के रूप में विकसित होय गेलै । नेपाली, हिन्दी आ मैथिली मे स्नातकोत्तर डिग्री प्राप्त केलनि आ बाद मे भाषा विज्ञान मे डॉक्टरेट के डिग्री सेहो पूरा केलनि ।

1973 मे त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय मे नेपाली के व्याख्याता के रूप मे शामिल भेलाह, दशकों तक चलय वाला शैक्षणिक कैरियर के शुरुआत केलनि. अध्यापन आ विद्वताक संग-संग चारि भाषा मे कथा, उपन्यास, निबंध, गीत आ गजलक निर्माण केलनि । हुनकऽ लेखन क॑ कक्षा के साथ-साथ साहित्यिक मंडली म॑ भी जगह मिललै, जेकरा स॑ हुनकऽ विचार क॑ अकादमी के दुनिया स॑ परे दर्शक मिललै ।

बिमल लेल मैथिलीक प्रचार-प्रसारक मतलब भाषाई वा क्षेत्रीय विशेषवाद मे पाछू हटब नहि छल । मैथिली विकास कोष के संस्थापक अध्यक्ष के रूप में ओ भाषा आ ओकर साहित्यिक परंपरा के संरक्षण आ आगू बढ़ेबाक काज केलनि आ संगहि व्यापक नेपाली साहित्यिक प्रतिष्ठान के संग मजबूत संबंध बनौने छलाह ।

ओ ब्रिजिंग भूमिका हुनक सार्वजनिक जीवनक केंद्रीय छल । ओ एकटा व्यापक नेपाली पहिचानक आवाज बनि गेलाह, जे देशक भाषाई आ सांस्कृतिक विविधता केँ चिन्हलनि, बिना ओहि मतभेद केँ संवाद मे बाधा बनय देलनि ।

भाषा आ साहित्य मे हुनक योगदान सँ मैथिली भाषी छात्र केँ नेपाली सीखबा मे मदद करबाक काज आ नेपालक बहुभाषी साहित्यिक परिदृश्य मे हुनक योगदान केँ सम्मानित करैत 2010 मे जगदम्बा श्री पुरस्कार भेटलनि । हुनका 2019 मे मधुपार्क ऑनर भेटल छल।

मधेश प्रांत के प्रमुख सुरेन्द्र लाभ न॑ हुनकऽ निधन क॑ देश केरऽ बौद्धिक संपदा केरऽ अपूरणीय क्षति बतैलकै ।

विश्लेषक चंद्र किशोर न॑ हुनका सांस्कृतिक संवाद म॑ एगो बुनियादी हस्ती के रूप म॑ याद करलकै, खास करी क॑ सामाजिक आरू राजनीतिक विखंडन के दौर म॑ तर्क आरू सामंजस्य के आवाज दै के क्षमता लेली ।

बिमलक जीवन आ काजक जड़ि जनकपुर मे छलनि, मुदा हुनकर चिन्ता कहियो एहि धरि सीमित नहि छलनि । अपन कैरियर ई पूछैत बिता देलनि जे नेपाल सन विविधतापूर्ण देश भाषा, जातीयता वा भूगोलक अंतर केँ देबाल नहि बनय देने अपना सँ कोना बाजि सकैत अछि ।

हिनक अंतिम संस्कार जनकपुरक स्वर्गद्वारी शवदाह गृह मे राज्य सम्मानक संग कयल गेल । हुनकऽ अंतिम संस्कार केरऽ जुलूस शहर केरऽ कई हिस्सा स॑ गुजरी क॑ संघीय आरू प्रांतीय मंत्री, प्रांत प्रमुख लाभ, विधायक, स्थानीय अधिकारी आरू शोक संतप्त लोगऽ के एगो बड़ऽ जमावड़ा क॑ आकर्षित करलकै ।

बिमल अपन पाछु दूटा बेटा आ एकटा बेटी छोड़ि गेल छथि।

Nepal’s digital government overhaul is facing mounting failures as demand outstrips capacity and critical national platforms buckle under structural constraints.

Failures in strategic and systemic planning have led to acute problems, argues an in-depth report in The Kathmandu Post. Nepal’s national identity infrastructure has seen extensive technical failures over the past weeks, leaving thousands unable to access services that are verified through the National Identity Management Information System (NIDMIS).
